Dear Friend,
Please join us at our upcoming Re-Election Rally and Picnic this Sunday, August 30th at 1 pm in Roslyn. The address will be provided upon RSVP.
This election, only 70 days away, will be one of the toughest yet. Trump won my district in 2024 by 19,000 votes, and he's coming to my district this Friday. JD Vance came in June and said I was the worst Congressman in America. I need your help in this election.
Let’s have some fun before we begin our march toward victory on November 3rd.

I want to tell you what this race is really about.

It's not just about flipping Ohio. It's not just about taking back the Senate. And it's certainly not about Democrats versus Republicans.

**This race is about whether Washington puts workers before billionaires.**

That's the heart of it.

I’ve always believed that the people who punch a clock, work the factory floors and farms, drive the trucks, care for patients, teach our kids – these folks deserve a voice in Washington.

They shouldn’t be pushed aside – they're the people who make this country work.

But that’s not how my opponent, Jon Husted, operates. Look at data centers: he recruited them to Ohio, cut them sweetheart tax deals, and when families saw the cost land on their electric bills, he told them the problem was that they use the internet.

When working people and powerful corporate interests end up on opposite sides, Husted picks the corporate interests. _Every time._

I'm running to give working people a voice in the Senate. But powerful special interest groups are spending a record-setting amount to attack me and stop our momentum.

name: Keisha Lance Bottoms
subject: I took a risk
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Aaron Ford
body:
There are moments in a campaign when waiting is the most expensive decision you can make.
This is one of them.
**This week, I authorized our campaign to begin placing a new major television ad, even though we haven't finished raising the money to cover the full buy.**
I don't love taking that kind of financial risk. But after my opponent, billionaire Rick Jackson, reserved $87 million in television advertising, I knew sitting on the sidelines wasn't an option.
**[Will you contribute $5 today to Aaron Ford and my campaign to help keep our new ad on the air and respond to Jackson's unprecedented spending?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260826_2_ak.uVjQre&amount=5&refcode=em20260826-768&t=2&akid=773%2E127862%2E2MbB4l)**
**[DONATE NOW](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260826_2_ak.uVjQre&amount=5&refcode=em20260826-768&t=3&akid=773%2E127862%2E2MbB4l)**
Rick Jackson is betting that if he spends enough money, he can hide the fact that he got rich by profiting off our health care. He wants to hide the fact that he promised to be “Trump’s favorite Governor,” and that there’s not a single thing he disagrees with Trump on.
He's betting that an $87 million wall of television ads will drown out every volunteer, every organizer, every small-dollar donor, and every conversation about what's really at stake in this election.
**I'm betting he's wrong.**
But only if we have the resources to fight back.
That's why I instructed my team to start locking in our own TV reservations. Every day we wait, ad inventory becomes more expensive, more limited, and more valuable. If we're going to compete, we have to claim our place on the air now—not months from now.
It's a big commitment for a grassroots campaign. But this campaign has never been built on billionaire checks.
It's been built by people giving what they can because they believe Georgia deserves a governor who will fight for working families—not another wealthy executive trying to buy public office.
Rick Jackson may have $87 million reserved.
We have each other.
If thousands of people step up today, we can fund these ads, compete on the airwaves, and prove that Georgia's governor isn't for sale.
**[Please contribute $5 today to my campaign and Aaron Ford to help fund our television campaign and defeat Rick Jackson this November.](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260826_2_ak.uVjQre&amount=5&refcode=em20260826-768&t=4&akid=773%2E127862%2E2MbB4l)**
Thank you,
Keisha Lance Bottoms

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_af_footer?refcode=em20260826-773-&t=5&refcode2=773_127862_2MbB4l&akid=773%2E127862%2E2MbB4l)**

body:
This is unlike anything we’ve seen in a while.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter. It's Gina.
We are officially less than 70 days away from Election Day, and every single day between now and November 3rd counts.
Over the past few months, I’ve traveled thousands of miles across Texas, meeting with working families in every corner of our state, and everywhere I go, Texans are demanding change.
My Campaign Manager Amy recently drafted a campaign memo outlining exactly where our race stands and what we need to execute in this final stretch to beat Greg Abbott.
**Please take a moment to read the memo.[If you don’t need more convincing and you’re ready to elect a new Governor, donate your first $5 to power our campaign.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20260826_4_memo.VptoFt&refcode=em20260826-1934&t=1&akid=1934%2E299639%2EG1UdZJ)**
[Donate »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260826_4_memo.Fk6y44&amount=5&refcode=em20260826-1934&t=2&akid=1934%2E299639%2EG1UdZJ)
=============================================================
**AUGUST 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON TX-GOV**
**FROM:** Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas
**TO:** Interested Parties
Let me tell you exactly where our race stands — because the numbers that just came in are unlike anything I've seen in this state in a long time.

**This race is now a one-point toss-up. And the momentum is entirely ours.
**
This trend line tells the story. At the start of this year, public polls showed Abbott ahead by 7–10 points. Then:

* TPOR (April 2026): Abbott +5
* TPOR (May 2026): Abbott +5
* TPOR (July 2026): Abbott +3, inside the margin of error
* Fox News (July 2026): Abbott +1, a statistical tie
* Texas A&M Bush School / Texas Pulse (August 2026): Abbott +1, a statistical tie

Two separate polls, from two independent organizations, now show a one-point race. As one Democratic strategist put it plainly to Newsweek: "Hinojosa has the momentum. This race has gone from a 10-point race to a 7-point race to a 5-point race to a 3-point race." It's now at 1.
And here's what makes this movement so significant: Gina is still introducing herself to Texas voters. In June, more than half of likely voters had no opinion of her. Today, fewer than one in three do. Her favorability has jumped from 31% to 43% in two months — entirely through earned media, social media, grassroots organizing, and Gina traveling every corner of this state. We _just_ launched our first TV ads this month.
**Abbott is underwater — and sinking.**
After 12 years as governor, Greg Abbott's job approval has flipped negative: 47% approve, 51% disapprove. More Texans disapprove of Abbott than approve of him. His favorability sits at 46% favorable, 50% unfavorable.
A three-term Republican incumbent whose own job approval has gone negative in Texas is an incumbent in serious trouble.
**The coalition Gina is building is exactly the one that wins this race.**
The July TPOR poll showed Gina leading among Latino voters by 38 points, independents by double digits, and Black voters by 49 points.
And then there's TX-15. A recent poll by House Majority PAC in that district — which Donald Trump carried 58–41 in 2024 — shows Gina leading Abbott 52–47. She is winning in Trump country. She is cutting into Abbott's base in territory Republicans have taken for granted for years.
This is not a narrow coalition. This is a new Texas majority being built in real time.
**Abbott's war chest is real — and it's built on corruption.**
Greg Abbott entered 2026 with $105.7 million on hand. His top donors include corporate executives, energy magnates, and data center developers — at a time when data centers are threatening to blow up Texas utility bills. He has handed out $1 billion in no-bid contracts to his donors. He rammed through a $1 billion school voucher scam after receiving the largest campaign contribution in Texas history from an out-of-state billionaire.
After 12 years, Texans are paying the price: the highest uninsured rate in the country, property taxes up 34% since 2019, school districts laying off staff and closing schools after Abbott held their funding hostage to pass his voucher scheme, and a power grid that failed catastrophically in 2021 and still hasn't been fully fixed.
The Greg Abbott Corruption Tax is real. Texans know it. The polls show it.
**Even Republicans are admitting this race is real.**
When a reporter asked outgoing Senator John Cornyn — who lost the Republican primary to Ken Paxton — whether Democrats have a chance in Texas this year, Cornyn said simply: "Yes." Asked again if he was sure, he said: "Yeah." That's the Republican who knows Texas best, in his own words.
**The governor’s race in Texas has national implications.**
The stakes go beyond the governor's race. Texas is growing at a rapid pace and is set to control nearly 10% of Congress by the end of the decade. With Texas Republicans committed to gerrymandering the state, they could draw maps so severe that it would be impossible for Democrats to win control of Congress for a generation. _Unless we elect a governor who will veto those rigged maps._
We are not just running for governor. We are running to reshape the entire political landscape in Texas and what happens here will impact the entire country. This race will determine who controls Congress for a generation.
**The bottom line.**
Abbott is scared. He's told his own donors he's at real risk of losing seats statewide. The polls — and now members of his own party — confirm it.
The coalition is here. The momentum is ours. Gina is closing fast in a state that hasn't elected a Democratic governor in 30 years — and she's doing it with a coalition of nearly 120,000 grassroots donors, no corporate PAC money, and a message that connects with Texans.
What determines whether we win is whether Democrats decide Texas is worth the investment. We can win this race if we all show up.
=============================================================
Now our job is to raise enough money to tell people who I am and what I’m about. That’s how we’ll close this final one point gap and win this race. We don’t have to raise as much money as Greg Abbott, but we need enough to communicate my message to Texas voters.
That's why I'm asking: **[will you back my campaign today in this final 10-week stretch with a donation of any amount today?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20260826_4_memo.VptoFt&refcode=em20260826-1934&t=3&akid=1934%2E299639%2EG1UdZJ)**
— Gina Hinojosa

Over the past few months, I’ve traveled thousands of miles across Texas, meeting with working families in every corner of our state, and everywhere I go, Texans are demanding change. My Campaign Manager Amy recently drafted a campaign memo outlining exactly where our race stands and what we need to execute in this final stretch to beat Greg Abbott. Please take a moment to read the memo. ============================================================= AUGUST 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON TX-GOV FROM: Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas TO: Interested Parties Let me tell you exactly where our race stands — because the numbers that just came in are unlike anything I've seen in this state in a long time. This race is now a one-point toss-up. And the momentum is entirely ours. This trend line tells the story. At the start of this year, public polls showed Abbott ahead by 7–10 points. Then: TPOR (April 2026): Abbott +5 TPOR (May 2026): Abbott +5 TPOR (July 2026): Abbott +3, inside the margin of error Fox News (July 2026): Abbott +1, a statistical tie Texas A&M Bush School / Texas Pulse (August 2026): Abbott +1, a statistical tie Two separate polls, from two independent organizations, now show a one-point race. As one Democratic strategist put it plainly to Newsweek: "Hinojosa has the momentum. This race has gone from a 10-point race to a 7-point race to a 5-point race to a 3-point race." It's now at 1. And here's what makes this movement so significant: Gina is still introducing herself to Texas voters. In June, more than half of likely voters had no opinion of her. Today, fewer than one in three do. Her favorability has jumped from 31% to 43% in two months — entirely through earned media, social media, grassroots organizing, and Gina traveling every corner of this state. We just launched our first TV ads this month. Abbott is underwater — and sinking. After 12 years as governor, Greg Abbott's job approval has flipped negative: 47% approve, 51% disapprove. More Texans disapprove of Abbott than approve of him. His favorability sits at 46% favorable, 50% unfavorable. A three-term Republican incumbent whose own job approval has gone negative in Texas is an incumbent in serious trouble. The coalition Gina is building is exactly the one that wins this race. The July TPOR poll showed Gina leading among Latino voters by 38 points, independents by double digits, and Black voters by 49 points. And then there's TX-15. A recent poll by House Majority PAC in that district — which Donald Trump carried 58–41 in 2024 — shows Gina leading Abbott 52–47. She is winning in Trump country. She is cutting into Abbott's base in territory Republicans have taken for granted for years. This is not a narrow coalition. This is a new Texas majority being built in real time. Abbott's war chest is real — and it's built on corruption. Greg Abbott entered 2026 with $105.7 million on hand. His top donors include corporate executives, energy magnates, and data center developers — at a time when data centers are threatening to blow up Texas utility bills. He has handed out $1 billion in no-bid contracts to his donors. He rammed through a $1 billion school voucher scam after receiving the largest campaign contribution in Texas history from an out-of-state billionaire. After 12 years, Texans are paying the price: the highest uninsured rate in the country, property taxes up 34% since 2019, school districts laying off staff and closing schools after Abbott held their funding hostage to pass his voucher scheme, and a power grid that failed catastrophically in 2021 and still hasn't been fully fixed. The Greg Abbott Corruption Tax is real. Texans know it. The polls show it. Even Republicans are admitting this race is real. When a reporter asked outgoing Senator John Cornyn — who lost the Republican primary to Ken Paxton — whether Democrats have a chance in Texas this year, Cornyn said simply: "Yes." Asked again if he was sure, he said: "Yeah." That's the Republican who knows Texas best, in his own words. The governor’s race in Texas has national implications. The stakes go beyond the governor's race. Texas is growing at a rapid pace and is set to control nearly 10% of Congress by the end of the decade. With Texas Republicans committed to gerrymandering the state, they could draw maps so severe that it would be impossible for Democrats to win control of Congress for a generation. Unless we elect a governor who will veto those rigged maps. We are not just running for governor. We are running to reshape the entire political landscape in Texas and what happens here will impact the entire country. This race will determine who controls Congress for a generation. The bottom line. Abbott is scared. He's told his own donors he's at real risk of losing seats statewide. The polls — and now members of his own party — confirm it. The coalition is here. The momentum is ours. Gina is closing fast in a state that hasn't elected a Democratic governor in 30 years — and she's doing it with a coalition of nearly 120,000 grassroots donors, no corporate PAC money, and a message that connects with Texans. What determines whether we win is whether Democrats decide Texas is worth the investment. We can win this race if we all show up. ============================================================= Now our job is to raise enough money to tell people who I am and what I’m about. That’s how we’ll close this final one point gap and win this race. We don’t have to raise as much money as Greg Abbott, but we need enough to communicate my message to Texas voters. includes Fox News.

[ Abdul ]Abdul talking with Jesse Watters on Fox News

Recently, I sat down with Jesse Watters. Not exactly friendly territory
for a Democrat running for Senate, but there was one thing that we
actually agreed on: Mike Rogers is a weak candidate.

I told Watters straight up, "Given the fact that Mike Rogers, who you
agree is a beta, is my opponent..." and I couldn't even finish the sentence
before he was laughing.

Watters can see it too. Mike Rogers spent his career in Congress cozying
up to lobbyists and voting to protect his special perks, then cashed in
with the corporations he used to regulate the moment he left. Now, he's
Trump's handpicked guy — because he does what he's told.

But the problem is, none of that matters if Michiganders never hear about
it. Mike Rogers has $51 million on his side to blanket the airwaves with
ads painting him in a positive light.

We don’t have the MAGA mega donor network to funnel tens of millions of
dollars into our own ad fund. Our campaign is counting on grassroots
contributions from folks like you to get the truth out to as many
undecided voters as possible.

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: ICE arrested a man at a Santa Fe clinic. Here's his record.
body:
Plus, a new poll has Haaland up 17 and it isn't worth much | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/tKIBo46vfRX?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | | ICE arrested a man outside a clinic in Santa Fe last week and his 11-year-old daughter was standing right there. Source New Mexico ran it. A congresswoman held a news conference about it the next day and introduced a bill. [Nobody mentioned that the same man had four charges against him in 2018](https://us.list-manage.com/fotKPt3TTkk?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) and every one of them got dismissed without a trial. There's also a poll out this week showing Deb Haaland up 17 in the Governor’s race. Don't believe it.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1853oSYj8dt?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 🔥 **THE PART THAT DIDN'T MAKE THE NEWS CONFERENCE**
The man ICE picked up had a case in Santa Fe County from 2018. Four charges, and they were serious ones. He was never convicted of any of them. When Mark pulled the record you can see why. There's a line next to all four counts and it says the same thing every time.
Mark put the whole record up on screen so you can read it yourself, because most of what's in there he can't say out loud without the video getting buried.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/SlXNOeY9EIQ?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 🚨 **GOV POLL SAYS 41 TO 24, AND YOU SHOULD IGNORE ALL OF IT**
Gabe Sanchez put out a poll this week that has Deb Haaland beating Gregg Hull by 17 points in the race for Governor, and it got picked up everywhere.
Mark's been on the ballot twice and has paid for more polling than he'd like to think about, so he went through this one line by line. He found four problems with how it was done.
**He also says there are two polls coming that are worth paying attention to, and he tells you roughly when they'll show up.

** 💰 **THEY WENT AHEAD AND SIGNED THE BILL ABOUT NICK SHIRLEY**
Nick was on the show about a month ago, right after California introduced a bill aimed at people who film and publish investigations into fraud. Newsom signed it Saturday.
The legislator who wrote the bill is married to California's Attorney General, and going after fraud is most of what an Attorney General does. Nick's take on what happens over the next year or so is worth hearing, because he's the one it's aimed at.

**AND CALIFORNIA IS COMING FOR YOUR TIRES**
A new rule out there requires about seventy percent of the tires sold in the state today to be off the shelf by 2033. The ones that replace them cost more, wear out faster, and don't hold the road as well when it's wet. If you drive a truck for work, you get the least choice about any of it.
We were just out there and the gas station had something posted right on the pump that tells you everything about how that state runs.

🏈 **FROM SHIPROCK TO THE DALLAS COWBOYS**
Shiyazh Pete went to high school in Shiprock, he's six foot nine, and he's the first member of the Navajo Nation ever to sign with an NFL team. He got in for a few snaps against the Cardinals on Saturday, fourth quarter, with the game already decided. Mark doesn't think he makes the 53-man roster, and he explains what he's hoping happens instead.
PLUS: Trump has dropped 51 points with Hispanic men since 2024 and Mark thinks the whole thing comes down to one issue. Rubio is beating Vance in every 2028 matchup that's been polled. Chris Wright came to Hobbs and made the case for nuclear. And Europe, after spending years lecturing this country about climate, is quietly undoing most of it.

Friend,
This race is heating up fast, but I wanted to pause for a moment to say **thank you**. This campaign would not be possible if it weren't for your incredible support.
Every day, people like you step up to power this movement.
You make it possible for me to become the first female Native American Governor in U.S. history. You make it possible for me to fight to protect our sacred land and make sure New Mexicans have access to the quality healthcare they deserve. Your support means I can fight for lower prices at the grocery store and the pump._**It’s all because of you, friend.**_
Our movement is rooted in the power of community, and I couldn't be more proud to fight for all New Mexicans with you by my side. Thank you so much for your continued support of my campaign. With this team behind me, we can achieve anything.
Be fierce,
Deb 💚

subject: We can’t stop thinking about this…
body:

Derek, do you remember the morning of November 5th, 2025? We can’t stop thinking about it. Abigail Spanberger won the Virginia governor's race, Mikie Sherill won the New Jersey governor's race, and Zohran Mamdani won the New York City mayoral election — just a few of our major victories. We saw the results of Democrats across the country showing up in full force. Together, we sent a clear, undeniable message to Donald Trump and his MAGA lackeys: **_We aren't done fighting._** A year ago, flipping the U.S. Senate looked like a long shot. **But you didn't listen to the skeptics.** Thousands of grassroots supporters across the country stepped up, fueled our work, and put Democrats within striking distance of taking back control. Now, about two months out, **YOU** have the power to flip Congress and put a check on the MAGA agenda. Our momentum isn’t a stroke of luck; it’s the direct result of year-round investment, grassroots organizing, and tireless work on the ground. We have under 70 days to reach every voter, make sure they have a plan for Election Day, and make sure that there’s a Blue Wave of turnout. Every conversation, every voter registered, and every dollar matters. The DNC is working around the clock to ensure campaigns have the resources to fight and win, but we cannot do it alone. But to keep our momentum going, we need a massive influx of resources. [**So if you’re ready to flip the Senate, we’re asking you to pitch in $7 today to send _another_ powerful message to Donald Trump and his allies: Last November’s victories weren’t a fluke — they were just the preview. And right now, we’re still 82 donations away from reaching our grassroots goal by the midnight deadline. = Most of the fair maps champions we support aren't in high-profile races. But they’re running for the state-level offices that have the most power over the redistricting process and access to the ballot box. That’s why they’ve made the cut for our Democracy Defenders program, where we focus on races that make a lasting difference for free and fair elections. And frankly, these are some of the elections where you get the most bang for your buck. Friend,
After the Supreme Court’s decision to allow the Trump administration to restrict mail on technical grounds, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson called out her colleagues for not clarifying:
_“When, exactly, is the right time to bring a meritorious election-rule claim challenging unconstitutional interference with electoral processes... even though the election cycle had started.”_
And after a Massachusetts federal judge lifted an injunction on Trump’s ballot order, 24 Democratic states and D.C. are now suing Trump to stop his plans to rig the game in his favor.
For years, Trump has opposed mail-in voting. He said mail-in voting would “end” the Republican Party and has vowed to “get rid of mail-in ballots.”
That’s why he’s demanding our Secretaries of State to submit personal, sensitive voter data to the Postal Service and Department of Homeland Security – he wants our private information in a government database to determine who is an eligible mail-in voter.
**Do you think that’s an administration who supports free and fair elections, friend?**
Democratic Secretaries of State have stood firm in the face of Trump’s threats, but they’re sounding the alarm.

| Friend,

| The Department of Justice has been busy under its new leader, Todd Blanche, Trump's former personal lawyer. _But they haven't been fighting crime._ On the contrary, **the DOJ seems to be gearing up to commit crimes of its own.**

| Donald Trump gave a national address on elections where he floated completely made up data and reheated debunked conspiracies to lay the groundwork to use unconstitutional and highly illegal actions to challenge the results of the upcoming midterms.
---
| Todd Blanche is putting Trump’s plan into motion. It was announced the DOJ will be sending **a record one thousand election monitors to polling locations** for the midterm elections**.**

It was Food Truck Friday in Opelika, and we were handing out cards. Things were going well when a gentleman approached me. I handed him one of my cards and said, "My name is Lee McInnis, and I'm running for Congress in Alabama's 3rd District."
He looked at the card for a minute and asked, "Are you a conservative?"
Since words can mean a lot of things in 2026, I asked what conservative meant to him. "Do you believe in lowering taxes?" he asked.
"Absolutely," I replied, "I believe in lowering taxes on working people and a tax code that taxes everyone fairly."
He nodded. "Okay, do you believe in small government?"
"Again, yes.," I said. "I believe the government should focus on programs that only it can do or that directly benefit the people. I don't believe the government has any place in your bedroom, bathroom, or doctor's office."
"What about the federal debt?" he asked.
"The federal debt reached $40 trillion today. That's ridiculous. We've got to get it under control."
He stared at my card for a really long moment. I couldn't wait for him to figure it out, so I just said, "You know, in 2026, all that makes me a Democrat... right?"
He looked as if he had been betrayed. As if I knew the words to the sacred chants, only to turn out to be a heretic anyway. The consternation on his face was profound. He mumbled something and walked off...

He argued that the U.S. needs significantly higher defense spending to rebuild military stockpiles and the defense industrial base, while expecting additional funding for military replenishment, agriculture, and intelligence programs. | 📰 == Alabama saw a 23% decline in ACA marketplace enrollment in 2026, with about 95,000 fewer people covered after enhanced federal premium tax credits expired, contributing to higher insurance costs. The article also highlights Alabama's lack of Medicaid expansion, warning that rising uninsured rates could increase pressure on hospitals already facing financial challenges. | 📰 == Gov. Kay Ivey announced 138 grants totaling more than $144 million through the Alabama Rural Health Transformation Program to improve healthcare access, quality, and outcomes across rural Alabama. The first round funds projects focused on rural healthcare, workforce development, mental health, healthcare practices, and health technology, with additional grants expected later. | A CALL TO ACTION | This won't be a year when we can sit back and expect everyone else to do the work. If you want to change the direction of the country, you have to get into the game. If you can help us with any of these efforts, drop us a note, and we will be in touch. Here is what you can do to help us win in November: | Events: We're a grassroots campaign, so we need to meet people face-to-face. If you're having a fall festival, food truck event, flea market, farmers market, or art fair, let us know. | | | Write postcards: we provide postcards, postage, addresses, and even a suggested message; all you need to do is write. | | | Canvassing: We need volunteers to help organize canvassing or work with other candidates to coordinate efforts. We can provide lists of addresses for potential swing voters and as many push cards as you want. | | | Phone banking: If your county already does phone banking, we can team with you to include our campaign in your message. | | | Host an event: We want to meet your friends. | | | Make a plan to vote: Tell everyone you know to vote, offer rides to the polls, THEN VOTE. | | One Last Thought Until Next Week | | | We closed out last week busier than we have ever been. The great thing was the number of people we met who were aware of the campaign and whom we'd never met before. That means we're getting the word out, and people can see they will have an alternative to the current political structure. Another thing we saw this week was people finally beginning to talk about the Republicans' refusal to debate any of us. We know why they won't. Now everyone is beginning to figure it out. Things are looking up at just the right time because we have 70 days until the general election. We'll talk soon, Lee | | | | == | == ---|--- == | == ---|--- == | == ---|--- mailto:?subject=Reminder%3A%20The%20Latest%20News%20from%20the%20Campaign&body= | mailto:?subject=Reminder%3A%20The%20Latest%20News%20from%20the%20Campaign&body= ---|--- | == == == | | | | Lee McInnis 4 Alabama | PO Box 111 | Opelika, AL 36801 US | | | | | | |

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
**August 26, 2026**
## DAN COX ACCEPTS OCTOBER 6 MPT DEBATE WITH WES MOORE, CALLS FOR TWO ADDITIONAL DEBATES
**ANNAPOLIS, MD** — Republican gubernatorial nominee Dan Cox today accepted Maryland Public Television's proposed **October 6, 2026 debate with Gov. Wes Moore** and called on Moore to agree to at least two additional debates before Election Day. The MPT debate is proposed as an in-studio, televised forum with questions from a panel of independent reporters and moderators. With mail-in ballots scheduled to begin going out September 21, Cox thanked MPT while arguing Maryland voters should have multiple opportunities to hear directly from both candidates. “I am honored, on behalf of the people of Maryland, to accept the debate with Wes Moore,” Cox said. “But Marylanders deserve more than one debate—and an opportunity to hear from both candidates before and while voting is underway.” Cox challenged Moore to participate in **at least two additional debates** , proposing Maryland colleges and universities as possible hosts, including Bowie State University, Morgan State University, Coppin State University and the University of Maryland. “What is he afraid of? Let's let the people hear from both candidates,” Cox said. “I welcome the opportunity to debate our different visions for Maryland—including my vision of lowering taxes and fees, making Maryland more affordable, reopening and bringing online new electric plants, expanding energy options, lowering crime and building the Key Bridge along with Maryland's bright future.”
### ###

## Meta to Pay $17B over Teen Addiction
Meta agreed to pay [up to $17 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupDAMRb8mdCDHQMgUKbahm223RJ7EDNl1YATWoP37J-Z9wuuOZOlY5_65T3fKktfnbyocdN6mlc9DWJX3qbDSwarCh9CaCu3_dM8kMiGgq8HXOEwUNb956qhKYWZGbisOdvCDx976tlqCB_DkbLK9tzeIGDvr2fWPFh0yQl_lcPnA42ABHGJDiXCeI_YD2hu4aDrglHXbm79bXnXhWf5vb96buJVKwqL6Okz7y-BocDzPs4nrI15Hg-OlNjiCv_iiq6o-tphJ6sIpU_2Jqr9LC6_aLFqk2kN6nVkkH24wHTwLZfk81B_u9A74FQAA__-imnuh) and overhaul how teenagers use Facebook and Instagram, settling claims from 29 states that its apps were designed to addict children. The deal ends what promised to be a landmark trial after one week. [The changes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAQhJ8GOiOzB9gULtLQXdqUaM-sOSf-OdkbTvf2EckjpJ2RRvN9H9f1ij74tL9jJMMur4meNRAzlTUSYyXmQDVg2iKWLy4eQ1hBwiSkFqBWtOwPWgdsN-OIgC4tmV5ppWHs9aW9G-dG5SZyuFk7SEWo7W2e5n6U2rleza03557UoHopJ4AONwTnLIwK-llOthkkbZ5z6T6zT3wnF175oNLZHNtg7syP2lzeGlgaWDLuncVuz0cDy0nTwPIoVKsoFAgrnQEy55LoJXZKVDCIW06MopL9LlQFF0zV5RLxhBO9Ejcfgs9J_PmIlFicetpitsfz7OqkmkHuEX34vcX_tHkY-AkAAP__KWeOaw) include teen accounts getting a two-hour daily default limit and a midnight to 6 a.m. blackout. Notifications go quiet during school hours, and stronger age checks aim to keep kids under 13 off entirely. The deal spares CEO Mark Zuckerberg a potential turn on [the witness stand](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2uozAQhuGrgc7IDD-GwsU2dNl2SzSxx-CNsSN7Nmzu_ojo3MHpR6_m-f7c1hv64OP2Gw_S7NIa6SyBmCmvBzEWYg5UAkZ7YH5w9hjCChJGIScBakXD_kVrj7XVjgioq0m3alITDO3U1bs2Cu7WglSjxbZ33eBMN5qpM-08y5mG2uurJydQrZQjQIMWwTkDg4J2lqOpeknWc8rN3-Qj7-TCO70oNyYdddA787NU3a8KlgqW8zwbl_7f_xUfqZTrpoKFyewxhbS9K1gumPiWCUeWMgbxoYkrK0xAfxTh0NA9pYfwsTBuGQ-B1nrDwuw-2Eyxzto-Tx-CL6Oqerkd6MPnK_7hmC8NXwEAAP__cvOOKg). California's attorney general said the settlement "will make social media less dangerous for our kids and make a world of a difference for children and their families." About $5.3 billion of the payout only arrives if TikTok and YouTube adopt matching limits. Meta is publicly urging both to sign on, and state officials say the changes begin rolling out within four to six months.
## Deadly Nepal Flood Kills Over 160
Flash floods devastated Nepal's Himalayan border region with China on Wednesday, killing at least 160 people and leaving more than 400 missing, reportedly including at least 54 Americans. Here's a [video of the destructive floodwaters](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDEO2zAMRU8jbwpkOrGUQUMXb-na0WAk2lZLS4ZEOMjtC_cK3R7wgAfy_3rNL0yc8voTd_KylDnTpzGJUJ13EmwkwtQYc9yx_pGakHkGA6M2ToOdMUg6ab5jF_1CBDR05HvrrINH74Zu84DBED6ds-NgzAhPoN68H46WMNjQ2y75q2cc2P7ycMOIsCwBHhb6pxmDuhuKSUq9_S4py0YLf8tJ9RbK3rHfRI6mhh8KJgVT_h6lyaUUTFdYwWTcxRd9SuWorycVTAuXEvWWpOmwpYw604Gs36VGqpoJz5RXvWP-6kgYNeao99RayquCqas-Hp_EnNpo1d2sOyb-d5L855Knh78BAAD__4EGiDs). An earthquake triggered a massive landslide that blocked the Bhote Koshi River, sending [walls of water through valleys](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuhDAQRU8DHcgMLDiFizR0mzYlGuzx2snYXuHRotw-IldI96QvvS-9z_t2x8gxPz4wkRFftkxnZRKhY0skWEmEqTJml_D4liMi8wYK5k7pDpYNrcQXbRO2zngioLElMyx60XAb9NgGszvn93n0evbTjB7cvkwTuEHtCsGPvo3m8ikNy6DUDNCjQ_Dewm2B4U3NtpkUuSjl6L9KzBLI80950dHbklo2QeRZm_G9gbWB9TzP3ubdXmMD66VuYFX64os8Yw2d51Jc7RyhhNqlWGvMjy7TE7mzIWbsgyRuD-OeZ2SOdV6aST0SRv57lX_Gehn4DQAA___ZtX8a) and destroying villages, roads, bridges, and six major hydropower facilities. Nepal's Tourism Board reported [341 foreign nationals unaccounted for](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O4zAMhJ_G7mzI9H-h4pp0ufZKg5aomLe0FUhMjH37hfMKW_EDiJnBzL_7ckcWPh5_cSerIS4HnVlIldKyk2ImVaEsePgd05cmRpEFDAyVmSoYF3TKb1o6LL0NREBtSbYZp3GCvpnacrPeedd38zCHsQfXt9gNbp1nWhuz-t6bku3lZyYYG2MGgBo9QggO-hGa2Qyu6Ax51pjq_5EP3SjId3xTql3cS7Gb6jMX7Z8CbgXczvOs3ZqvHte_gNuFn_NEqYJg3qogMfpK4ytx1lztnDMfj4oPJy9_Ee6U2OFxCctk_fNkEc7DWHTmsSPLJ1t_Odnbwk8AAAD__16mhAY), including 133 Indians on pilgrimage to Tibet's Mount Kailash and tourists from at least 26 countries. Rescue helicopters have been unable to land in the hardest-hit areas. The death toll and number of missing kept growing through the day.
## Map: If Your State Were a Country
A [new map matches every U.S. state](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuu5CAQAE9jZ1i4_YEJCDZxNptuaPVCM2YXjAU9tnz7p3lXeHmpSqo_z_WJIYb99RsTGfZ53emqkZiprIkYKzFHqhF3l7D85xIwxhUkzEJqAWpFy-GkdcTWGU8ENLRkeqWVhqnXQ7sZ7wYHeoLZjdq66TGPf2lE9RjIDZN1vg3m45MaVC_lDNChQ_DewqSgf8jZNqMkFziX7l8OO2_k451PKp3NqY1mYz5qM_xqYGlgua6rO0N9Y7R4BMYYKn_ABpaEx0FO0EnlFm9RRWVkEmTzntMtErLdyAnOAoXN753L3cDSFuOOK8QY6qyaUb4Shvid5h8eOw18BQAA__8BZoO3) to the country closest to it in gross domestic product, showing that California's $4.3 trillion economy rivals the United Kingdom's, Texas' $2.9 trillion GDP matches Russia's, and New York lines up with Canada's. The data show that Florida parallels Australia, Illinois matches Saudi Arabia, and four states alone would each qualify as G20 economies. The full U.S. total of $30.8 trillion roughly equals China, Germany, and Japan combined. [Vivek is running for Governor of Ohio to build a firewall against that radicalism.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
But we cannot be asleep at the wheel. The Democrat machine is flooding Ohio with money. And the latest poll shows Vivek is trailing by just ONE point.

clean_body: I couldn't have done this without you, but we cannot take a day off. We need to look to November. | Thank you, Fellow Patriot. It's been a long six weeks, but because you were by my side, we won. Your generosity helped us through the Special Election Primary and through a head-to-head runoff. But that was just the first step to securing this seat. I am the first woman United States senator in South Carolina history. My Democratic opponent, Dr. Annie Andrews, cannot be the second. Here's where the race stands. Two statewide elections in less than 6 weeks were expensive. We knew it would be a tough battle - it was. We did not want to leave anything to chance, so we had to ensure every dollar we raised was well spent on television ads, voter contacts, and signs across South Carolina. We are starting at square one, going into the general election, and let me tell you about our Democrat opponent. She's raising millions from liberal donors who want nothing more than to flip this seat and stop President Trump's agenda in Washington. I need your help again, Fellow Patriot. Now that we're in the general election, we need to compete with the liberal money flooding South Carolina. I hate to ask for your help again, especially when you've been by my side for the last six weeks, but I wouldn't ask if I didn't need it. We won Tuesday night, but that's just the beginning. Let's make sure we win again in November. Thank you, Darline Graham P.S. Thank you for being by my side over the last few weeks. It means so much to me. On a strategy call with my deputy campaign manager, he abruptly paused.
"I think Tim Burchett's campaign manager just subscribed to our communications. Let me make sure." _He sure has._
**We 've known for a while that Tim's getting nervous.** This is a race he shouldn't have to break a sweat to win. This district has been red since Reconstruction. He's the incumbent. He has the President's endorsement, corporate PAC money, and the whole MAGA machine.
**I 'm a Democrat, a first time candidate, a woman, who is funded by grassroots donors.**
Why would his campaign manager have to subscribe to our campaign to get updates on what we're doing? I have dozens of former Burchett supporters forwarding me his emails, texts, ads, and mailers on a daily basis.
I'll tell you why: **Our campaign is making Tim work harder than he ever has, and houses he thought he didn 't have to canvass because they were "reliable" votes are now voting for me.**
East Tennesseans aren't buying his bluster, even if it comes in a Carhartt with a whole bunch of dadgums to punctuate it.
What Tim fails to understand is that you have to back up words with actions. You can't just rage against the system when you're a lifelong politician who's helped create it. At a certain point, folks want receipts. They want you to deliver.
So when Tim tells us **he 's in DC to fight for working class folks but then votes for permanent tax breaks for the wealthy while the tax cuts on tips and overtime disappear in two years** . . . we see through it.
When he **acts like a critic of the Washington elite but then spends thousands of dollars at the Capitol Hill club** . . . we see through it.
When he **calls me a radical for wanting East Tennesseans to have healthcare they can afford, good paying jobs, a government that serves us, and an economy that works for the working class** . . . we see through it.
We know there's only one radical in this race. We know there's only one person who has sold out to the swamp. And it's not me.
_**P.S. Hi Thomas! If you 're reading this, could you let Tim know that I'd be happy to set up a debate? You can set the time and place. Just make sure anyone can attend, not just folks who've passed one of your ideological screener questions to gain access.**_

A person may see something that does not seem right but not know where to turn. Someone in danger may desperately need a way to reach out. You can help someone in the grip of a trafficker who wants to break free. This 24/7 hotline provides real people waiting for that call. This visible hotline could facilitate a victim's safe and secure exit from the life of enslavement, and the next steps to begin a new life journey.All calls are 100% confidential.

A child, teen, or young adult trapped in trafficking may be searching for a way out. Seeing that number could give them the courage to make one call -- **a call that could be their first step toward freedom.** Something as small as a sticker can carry such an important message. **You are not alone.** **There is a number to call.** **There are people willing to act.** That's also why I believe awareness must lead to action. The film _Sound of Freedom_ brought the horror of child trafficking before millions of people. But a movie alone cannot end this evil. So we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** to carry this mission forward. We work to help prevent exploitation, support intervention efforts, educate parents and communities, spread information, and influence policies that protect children.
---
[ Yes, I'll carry the number](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckT9v3DAMxT-NvMWwJMfWDRoKHLylQ1Ggo0BTlC1Eslz9SZFvX_guY6eOJB_fw4_89WbewAd_bN8hks7VmVzMHx_CZ2o7hfNste6-HC2ulMmIQUwvg3oRswGs_oPMCJ3VFi1w7EjzWc1KqPE2dbsmASt3XFk336QkRDvD6oArWG98Fa-d15ffoMTM-cDlaz_ROoEYUVoEcArYOECgXPtMZ1uDRzgqlHeXMlKPKXZB77WehclvTCxMLIWwZepLaodNzmUim6K7Kqg-HX3K26VKziDk_PnEelAZwN9MLiW1jGQwWWLy_uPnwqUQ042JqdVoIlnfIpN3iuDDV_O5wuR9h2yhvD-cniOEeILfDibv_8r8UlXKl2eXtT2v0_syzWwctivjQVn_8zEfWvwNAAD__0kbpQc)

Now remain in my love."_ (John 15:9) Every child has God-given worth. Every child deserves protection. And every one of us can choose whether we look away or act. Friend, today I am asking you to act. Make your first gift to the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Your generosity helps fuel our larger mission to protect vulnerable children and fight exploitation. [**And with your gift of $10, $15, $25 or whatever you can do today, we'll send you a ****_Carry the Number_**** sticker pack.**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckT9v3DAMxT-NvMWwJMfWDRoKHLylQ1Ggo0BTlC1Eslz9SZFvX_guY6eOJB_fw4_89WbewAd_bN8hks7VmVzMHx_CZ2o7hfNste6-HC2ulMmIQUwvg3oRswGs_oPMCJ3VFi1w7EjzWc1KqPE2dbsmASt3XFk336QkRDvD6oArWG98Fa-d15ffoMTM-cDlaz_ROoEYUVoEcArYOECgXPtMZ1uDRzgqlHeXMlKPKXZB77WehclvTCxMLIWwZepLaodNzmUim6K7Kqg-HX3K26VKziDk_PnEelAZwN9MLiW1jGQwWWLy_uPnwqUQ042JqdVoIlnfIpN3iuDDV_O5wuR9h2yhvD-cniOEeILfDibv_8r8UlXKl2eXtT2v0_syzWwctivjQVn_8zEfWvwNAAD__0kbpQc) Then I want you to do something important with it. **Carry it. That's why I am writing to you today. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I am the producer of the film Sound of Freedom and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. We have created a special pack of Carry the Number stickers printed with a rescue hotline number. When you make your first gift of any amount to the Sound of Freedom Foundation , we will send you a sticker pack so you can help put this important number into your community. Put one in your car. A person may see something that does not seem right but not know where to turn. Someone in danger may desperately need a way to reach out. You can help someone in the grip of a trafficker who wants to break free. This 24/7 hotline provides real people waiting for that call. This visible hotline could facilitate a victim's safe and secure exit from the life of enslavement, and the next steps to begin a new life journey.All calls are 100% confidential. A child, teen, or young adult trapped in trafficking may be searching for a way out. ## Meta to Pay Texas $1 Billion
Meta will pay Texas more than $1 billion and cap teen users at two hours a day on Facebook and Instagram under a [settlement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOrDAMQE8TuowSAxOmSPEbuvntlsgQA5FCgoiHGW6_Amn3Attaftbz-3p2T_TBx-k_LmT5M6Yu0jsHYqatW4iR04oH0wez7suDcOtxmDtQcJeqkWA6HNjv1FVYONsr99AFWW0a00BTl49itmQU1GhMOVRQ1toZVLqvjXZYUzWOUHh7nlMNGK0VaLiNpTGuJtIVaESHolLkPKftxjNdLmM40k7bbUhLEezMvGZR_hPQCmgzRowThRT8TueGgPZ8SkB7sQLaX_37z1DiJFf8cIoSY0yvOFCWWvY-BJ-iXMMryzOHzMQcaKHIMtJbDrMPTmYciQ-5vQLlYrNufZ9cvhtRqWlBHy5R_mvg3cJ3AAAA__9N-pH-) Attorney General Ken Paxton announced Wednesday. The deal requires muting notifications during school hours unless a parent changes the setting, [hiding likes and reactions](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd0QwxgYXLrahe9tuaQ0wPKPFIbLnxcnfr-Jf2HI00tE598_X8oWllvv3b9xo5lduy53OoxIz7ctGjNwe-GZ64aFD_ybcA8Z1AQWjVE6CXTByedJisEtzUGnSHc3aOuvADf3UrbMZY0ixDyqoMGlntRuVVVM2Zsyjc6Yr8wenHFitFWi45d7aNBBpAxoxoTCKUuG233ilyyXXd3vSfott6-q8Mj8O0f8S4AX48zxvf9f283kK8LhziZUE-E-ZAF9bxCrAXyAB_lMpr0MexFxpoztLJrpLPptc288ua9kKC_DgBolJTQQDypxDlmYcUCIkJa2xcYyDNgB9t8_pcZZayzFaYdT3hqVetvy_Kz9n-BcAAP__t_OP9w), and restricting nighttime access. Meta also agreed to tighter age checks. The [funds will pay for](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2y4yAQhE-DMlww-oEXEGyi7G26oWoEI4taDCo0a9m338JXeFkHPfN195_v5Rtjivn-Gx_k-LWVJdN1JmKmujyIkcuBb6YXnnrt34R1Rb8voGCSykowC3qOT1oG7IJbVfjSHTltrLFgx_6r2501fa-8GvppCjT166hG3PS4ofdKW7110bV3yoLRWoGG29YbE0YiPYBGDCgGRSFyqTfe6ZNlS-_ypHrz5dEltzMfp-h_CZgFzNd13XyK_i_s5d_JJTeXgLkVEzCn4jEJmBtTwKxs0021tpKLPPAtPxDZEFLLNaYUS5Z4r0TNkemSRy1MnmPJp9xKlX6PKVTKsuQUMwmYu-rCcbXbczJiUPcHxvRJzD9d-ungfwAAAP__mKyTrw) youth mental health services, digital literacy, after-school programs, and school grants. "_This is a historic settlement and a major win for the safety of Texas children_ ," Paxton said. The Texas deal is separate from a roughly [$18 billion agreement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAQhZ8GM6agdcQJCDYxu5tuaLXQKnURLOn1jm-_xbzCZqeqf75zzp-v6QtDDGn9jTtZfi95SvRTIjHTOe3EyPnAm-mNRc_tTXjO6LYJFPRSDRLMhI7DRVOHjbez8i_dkNVmMAMMz_bVbLbre-cX_dJ9542ah06Tb5FgVv7pegdNsPWdGsBorUDDY2mN8U8i3YFG9Cg6RT5wPh-80cfLEu980flweW-i3ZiPItpfAkYB4_cVsA4EjDWLgHH-W0KiUiST21KOeb0FjBUqYFRD1VXVuJKzXMNF8oORFSK1nEOMIScZkizEHGmnxHX1ODOTY_kdfJE5xZBIwNic1h8_9ab0RnRq3THEj1f-344vC_8CAAD__8YzkhM) Meta reached the same day with 33 other states over claims its platforms harmed teens. It's Paxton's third settlement above $1 billion with a tech company. He goes to trial against TikTok this fall.
## Ross Fire Knocks Out Power
Hundreds of homes and businesses near Possum Kingdom Lake lost power on Wednesday after the Ross Fire [burned 300 power poles](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd0TwjA0UFNu4m223tB7wnCCRYOE38eTvV8kvTH2le889_77WLyy1PK5_8U6Bf7a2Pug8KjFTX-_EyG3HF9MPHjqOL8IeMd1WUDBL5STYFROXJ60Ghxyiyl4PFLR11oGbRj_cAsW4zcl40Hkm5XSa0E44JvDoTAY_lPCuUw6s1go0XLbR2jwRaQMaMaMwinLh1i98ow_LVl_tSf2S2n2o4ca8H2L8I2ARsJzneTk3xHcoYMHOJVUSsLyfCVhqS1gFLL0dh9xKJ7m3k7ps34xXOuSOtcm9PLjJ1L4f_JKfSQELOCvBekgmTtLOM0pDRBLzlOSIs7Peb2O0cegh72eptRyzFUZd71jqh5V_6_gZ4H8AAAD__51YkF8) in Palo Pinto County. The fire broke out Monday afternoon [about 60 miles west of Fort Worth](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-ysyAQxZ9GOxxYiWBB8TXp8rW3dFZYIzMoGdjE5O3vmFe41WnO_M6fn9t0w5jifv-PGzl-L3na6aiJmKlMGzFyfuCH6Y1Vzf2HsMzo1wkkDEJaAWZCz_FFk8Y2uFmGUbXklLHGgr30Y7s6P_pBD6PGwWrwNEgrjYIQFkm9WfTcRnfipAWjlAQF3dIbEy5ESoNCDNhoSSFyLh2v9O2ypE9-Uel83trkVuZHbfp_DVwbuB7H0S35DcOan5XzfpoauJ67TsmFV_GFiCOmsMRCYn6WvQorpZQCfaEqYhUKhM87Y9wptMWFxxFTinUwjZb3DWP6pvNfX3s5-A0AAP__hiGCpw) and has since blackened 80,000 acres with 12% containment as of Wednesday morning. Crews rebuilt lines along Highway 254 overnight, only to watch flames flare back up and take them out again. About 100 line workers are on the ground, and [bulldozers are clearing](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypSAQhJ8GM04B_mFAsInZ3XRDa8RRpxbBgtnj8e23vK9w467q_vr78zV9AQWK22840PFnTVPEqwRkxjwdyMDphJvxA0XP9Y2QZ_D7ZJTppLLS9BN4pjdODVSLm9Uy6Aqd7m1vjW3rodrdMNu2sarrZrvOgzLeajt0CmbVrbb1WJF76pQ1vdbKaPNa675fWkTdGA2wgGgULsQpv3jHb5Y13OmN-eXTUQW3M59F1L-EGYUZr-t6_eVyPKEw4_NHmDGnUuRKGSVFeUJI8qTISfr0L_It8XNiJoweiyy0RVrJQ2S55XTxLp-xSNvOwoxVdst5UQhUul40ajuAwjcJ_9Tg25n_AQAA__-OFYjS) burned debris to open a path into areas crews still can't safely reach. The fire ran toward the town of Bryson in Jack County overnight before crews stopped it [outside the town limits](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGS3CAQRL8GZWzBCAQKFDhRdk4dqmZhdMKLhArGq9u_d-0F_gGn3V1dr_vXx_KBKafj8yfuNPHXWpaDrpaJmeqyEyOXE19MX9j0vX8R1juGbQEFg1ReglswcHrSYrCL013FUXc0aeedB2_7sdum4CP0sff-HvygR6tI-TVEILOaIVjbpeldpzw4rRVouK29c9ESaQMaMaIwimLiUm-80TfLml_lSfUWyt7laWM-m-h_CJgFzNd13R6BDn6-bQEzVk4hk4D5vU3AnEvA_E5uVEmmJn9jeMhQ_hz8kv_EE3ORZzq4yFpak2uqJHc8ZU3tIWAG76QNHpSJVhpllTTeghxxDHJFBcMYlXbouzrF80o5pzY4YdTnjil_k_P_Pv6c4G8AAAD__yQrlAg). If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

The Justice Department sued an Ohio court on Tuesday over a rule requiring a judicial warrant before immigration agents can make arrests on courthouse grounds, arguing a local court cannot bind the federal government. ---
The State Department confirmed plans to strip visas from as many as 200,000 foreign visitors who entered on tourist or business visas and then filed for asylum, in what officials call the largest mass revocation in US history. name: Bill Gray
subject: Can the truth become outdated?
body:
Is truth relative?

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcFunDAQhp_G3EBmbNbkwCEqu6cmVZNKUU_I2LMwksEWHqevX6FuXyDX_x99nzT_x8v0YinQvrzaDQfKefLRT87uvCIfhdcZXdwwFvaW0U8g4VLLvgYzWcf0iZO2lR86aPt7X-HQmt70CqBV1To82XvnNMx2nudZ952Sxhhp54uVxrWyq2g4ebIH04JU8NTce9Vp7VG1oGXrtdCypNPc0J7JY3YxphQDMbncxGOpwrAypyzUs4CbgFtGVw5sVgohexuwQV8E3HzcLePZl5TiwTWvWFMg64W6ZVw23Plb9CjUKJVs1asEDd-v4_hjvF7fBVwKb1OO5XDnSTpiTuiY9uVRbeipbEKNuFkKj9DZLVladqHGf6pHHHfGnYUalZTy9_X57X36aeqPX2_1_3dUx-DTHwqB8sUILZeT2ri4VfzVkT4H-BsAAP__geWh1A)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, **Is truth relative?** That’s a question our culture answers very differently than it did even a generation ago. Many students today are taught that truth changes with the times—that each person has their OWN “truth,” and that yesterday’s convictions should give way to today’s feelings. **Hillsdale College is different. We pursue truth and defend liberty** and provide “sound learning” of the kind needed to preserve “the blessings of civil and religious liberty.” **[That’s one reason we created our free online course, “The Iliad.”](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcFunDAQhp_G3EBmbNbkwCEqu6cmVZNKUU_I2LMwksEWHqevX6FuXyDX_x99nzT_x8v0YinQvrzaDQfKefLRT87uvCIfhdcZXdwwFvaW0U8g4VLLvgYzWcf0iZO2lR86aPt7X-HQmt70CqBV1To82XvnNMx2nudZ952Sxhhp54uVxrWyq2g4ebIH04JU8NTce9Vp7VG1oGXrtdCypNPc0J7JY3YxphQDMbncxGOpwrAypyzUs4CbgFtGVw5sVgohexuwQV8E3HzcLePZl5TiwTWvWFMg64W6ZVw23Plb9CjUKJVs1asEDd-v4_hjvF7fBVwKb1OO5XDnSTpiTuiY9uVRbeipbEKNuFkKj9DZLVladqHGf6pHHHfGnYUalZTy9_X57X36aeqPX2_1_3dUx-DTHwqB8sUILZeT2ri4VfzVkT4H-BsAAP__geWh1A)** For nearly **3,000 years** , readers have returned to Homer’s epic because **it tells the truth about the human condition:**
* It shows what pride can do to a great man.
* It shows why loyalty and friendship matter.
* It shows that courage demands sacrifice.

And it reminds us that there is **a moral order greater than ourselves.** **Those lessons aren’t relics of the ancient world. They’re as true today as they were when Homer first wrote them.** But too many young Americans never encounter books like _The Iliad_. Instead, they’re taught that truth is something we create for ourselves. **A free society cannot endure if it forgets the difference. |

Peter, I’m not asking for your money. Let me explain.
President Trump has endorsed my MAGA opponent and attacked me online. Stephen Miller has gone on Fox News to rant and rave about me. GOP dark-money groups are spending millions to run ads statewide with baseless lies about my record.
**Simply put, I can’t win this race without people like you on my side.**
So all I’m asking is that you be one of the 30,000 folks l need to endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina today. [**_Will you take 30 seconds now to add your name?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2608-email-rf?source=email_su_pros_jtk1177&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=3031%2E124072%2Ev6P9oO)

Whether as a state legislator or Attorney General or Governor, I’ve fought hard to protect our fundamental rights, expand health care and put working families first.

Peter, We’re not even through the midterms, and yet: **We’re about to get hit by the next wave of the redistricting crisis.** Mississippi Republicans just laid the groundwork to redraw their state’s congressional, state legislative, and state supreme court maps for the 2028 elections. And they’re not alone — GOP lawmakers are eyeing new gerrymanders in Georgia, South Carolina, Kansas, and Indiana. **But at the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, we’re not just sitting on our hands waiting for Republican map manipulators to do their worst.** [**We’re fighting back to stop new gerrymanders — in fact, we’re also organizing to combat already-passed GOP redraws. Our north star is a national House map that reflects the will of the people. And we’re counting on your support — can you rush a donation of any amount today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137995946/642660916/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_MapManipulations_email_20260827-NDRC-Tier1-MapManipulations_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260827-NDRC-Tier1-MapManipulations_&utm_campaign=MapManipulations&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhmMGQ5MzRlLTEwYTItZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWJlYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=UfAaciCFERtuzJljdUGG8nWMJyy20ZZ8Tv4oiRvHBEs=) The GOP is already looking ahead to 2028, and the ink is barely dry on the maps they manipulated for this year’s midterms. First, Donald Trump launched his Republican allies into a shameful, unprecedented frenzy of mid-decade redistricting to try to lock in power. Then the Supreme Court ruling in _Callais_ handed the GOP a tool to lock in power by ripping fair representation away from Black and brown voters. All in all, Republicans have been able to cheat their way into an unearned advantage for the 2026 elections. Now we know that even if they STILL lose their U.S. House majority this November, they plan to steal it right back in 2028 through even more redraws. So we’re racing to elect Democracy Defenders who can prevent new GOP gerrymanders and bad, anti-voter legislation. We’re supporting voter-led countermeasures in states like New York and Maryland. clean_body: Fighting back starts now. | Peter, We’re not even through the midterms, and yet: We’re about to get hit by the next wave of the redistricting crisis. Mississippi Republicans just laid the groundwork to redraw their state’s congressional, state legislative, and state supreme court maps for the 2028 elections. And they’re not alone — GOP lawmakers are eyeing new gerrymanders in Georgia, South Carolina, Kansas, and Indiana. But at the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, we’re not just sitting on our hands waiting for Republican map manipulators to do their worst. = The GOP is already looking ahead to 2028, and the ink is barely dry on the maps they manipulated for this year’s midterms. First, Donald Trump launched his Republican allies into a shameful, unprecedented frenzy of mid-decade redistricting to try to lock in power. Then the Supreme Court ruling in Callais handed the GOP a tool to lock in power by ripping fair representation away from Black and brown voters. All in all, Republicans have been able to cheat their way into an unearned advantage for the 2026 elections. Now we know that even if they STILL lose their U.S. House majority this November, they plan to steal it right back in 2028 through even more redraws. So we’re racing to elect Democracy Defenders who can prevent new GOP gerrymanders and bad, anti-voter legislation. We’re supporting voter-led countermeasures in states like New York and Maryland. body:
As union membership decreases, income and wealth inequality increases.
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=54%2E42639%2EH2Xa3n)
Look at this chart shared by former Labor Secretary Robert Reich.
[](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q3.tyfWFC&refcode=em260827&t=2&akid=54%2E42639%2EH2Xa3n)
What it shows is clear: over the last century, as union membership increases, income and wealth inequality decreases.
As union membership decreases, income and wealth inequality increases.
In other words – the stronger the labor movement, the better working people everywhere do.
And I stress – the stronger the labor movement, the better working people EVERYWHERE do.
Why is that?
Not only do unions often win better wages, working conditions, and benefits for their members, but when those unions win contracts they end up driving up wages and benefits for workers in similar industries all across the country.
That’s exactly why the corporate bosses have waged an all-out assault on unions as part of the decades-long crushing of the American Dream. That is why, when workers try to organize, the bosses often engage in illegal union busting campaigns.
Now I am from sacred ground for the labor movement and helped organize a union with the Steelworkers. And we know that a union can be a strong check against runaway corporate power.
Our job is to make sure that all Americans understand that as well. That when they see workers fighting to form a union or ratify a contract, they show solidarity with them.
The good news is, the American people are coming back around to that. Polls show support for unions are increasing and are near recent all-time highs.
But we still have a lot of work to do.
Let's get it done.
Don't give up the ship.
Chris Deluzio

* * *

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

Dear Friend of Life, **It can cost the abortion industry as little as $5 to get in front of a woman searching online for abortion pills.** That should stop us in our tracks. Imagine a woman who has just discovered she is pregnant. She wasn’t expecting this. She may be worried about money, insurance, child care, or how she could possibly have this baby. She is frightened, overwhelmed, and looking for someone to tell her what to do next. So she reaches for her phone. Within moments, she can find an abortion provider ready to sell her pills that will end her pregnancy and the life of her baby—all without ever walking into an abortion facility. **But what if she found hope instead?** PreBorn! is a Christian ministry dedicated to saving babies from abortion and seeing lives transformed through the gospel of Jesus Christ. Our Network Clinics across America provide free ultrasounds to women facing unexpected pregnancies. When a mother has the opportunity to see her baby and hear the heartbeat, what once felt like an impossible situation can suddenly look very different. But the way women are making decisions about abortion has changed. **Approximately 70% of abortions now happen through abortion pills.** Today, we cannot simply wait and hope a frightened mother walks through the doors of a pregnancy clinic. If women are going online looking for abortion, **we have to reach them there—and we have to reach them first.** That is why PreBorn! is expanding our reach through our Virtual Care System. Through this innovative approach, we can reach women while they are looking online for answers and create an opportunity for them to connect with something profoundly different from the abortion industry: **A real person who cares about her and her baby.** A registered nurse can listen to what she is facing without judgment, answer her questions, provide pregnancy education, help identify the pressures influencing her decision, and connect her with a local PreBorn! Network Clinic where she can receive an ultrasound and continued support. And when welcomed, our nurses can pray with these women and offer them the eternal hope of Jesus Christ. Friend of Life, think about the difference. The abortion industry is prepared to meet a frightened woman online and sell her pills to end the life of her baby. [**PreBorn! wants to meet her with a compassionate human being who will slow down, listen to what she is facing, and help her discover another path forward with her baby.**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb-O3CAQh58Gd7vCAwa7cHGK5UtzyaZKac0B9o4OAwJ2T_f2kaNdKXXK3zejT_Pn99vyhuQpbD9wd-MWU1pyWfA95koxUInBf6HxZD7wE78W4KBOvD-BXtBUurtFYmNHiUoqpRo3trrXvZC61c115Ova2mFA5AMqAajBtitfu1Yqq9TgGhoPIe9BtyC7tjs7A51WLTo92BV4xyR3lmrM52O07ApZFyqhP5u4N3681poKEy8MZgbzRncK2zll9x5zOFoYzI_EYDZXZz7irTKY0aQr70F5JubCxPTy7fL9yK8XBsrgnpC2wMQkBQxaMFC3ui8l3rJxTEwpx5KcqRS2R2l3lm47E5PbkfwD_uO5m_KEMVQXKhPTL316_Xm5nJ4naPJo0yd5T0VpJvl2qP7uWf_zMfcR_gQAAP__D7-cXA) That is the opportunity your generosity can help put in front of her. $5 a week from now till Election Day. That's really it. People sometimes ask me, "do small amounts like this really help?"
I know for many people that might not sound like a lot of money. But campaigns like ours run on donations about this size, and monthly grassroots support makes a bigger difference than you'd think. Let me explain why. A lot of smaller donations can add up to a lot. And when folks commit to giving weekly, it means we can make better plans for the final stretch in October than we would otherwise, because we know we can count on your donation.
I first ran for the state legislature to represent Nash County, where I was born and raised. I worked hard serving my community, and voters have continued to put their trust in me since then. I don't take that for granted. I've fought to earn that trust, and I work just as hard to keep it.
Communities deserve leaders who are accountable to them, and will show up and fight for them every day. That's why I'm running for U.S. Senate: to make a real difference for North Carolina's working families. With less than 68 days to go, this race is not going to be easy, especially since the Republicans have made me their top target.
They've already poured nearly $100 MILLION so far into attacking me. We don't have that kind of money, and they know it. But we also can't let the GOP and their dark money allies buy this seat for Washington DC insider Michael Whatley.
[So here's one of the most powerful things you can do for this campaign: set up a small, monthly donation.](https://substack.com/redirect/d2d0a32b-ccfa-4f78-8e58-033f10e7c082?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Right now, your [$5 a week](https://substack.com/redirect/d2d0a32b-ccfa-4f78-8e58-033f10e7c082?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) helps us keep our ads on the air, on streaming and on social media to reach as many voters as possible.
In September, your [$5 a week](https://substack.com/redirect/d2d0a32b-ccfa-4f78-8e58-033f10e7c082?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) helps us talk with voters all across the state about what's really on the line this election.
And in October, your [$5 a week](https://substack.com/redirect/d2d0a32b-ccfa-4f78-8e58-033f10e7c082?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) helps make sure that every eligible voter in North Carolina votes before the polls close on Election Day.
**So I 'm asking you directly: Will you start a weekly donation of $5, or whatever you can today, so we can respond to the GOP's attacks, flip North Carolina and take back the Senate for the people?**

|
Peter,
Last night, the Supreme Court allowed the Trump admin to move forward with its attempt to effectively ban mail-in ballots in blue states.
The far-right Roberts Court used the "shadow docket" to hand down this ruling. No signed opinion. No reasoning to scrutinize. No oral arguments. Just a 6-3 order along ideological lines that will cause mass chaos and confusion this November.
The Court did not even rule on whether the new USPS rule is legal. Instead, they ruled on a technicality, claiming the blue states who challenged the rule sued too early, before it was finalized. That final rule dropped Friday night, just days before the Court's ruling.

Mail-in ballots start going out in less than a month in some states. This ruling forces blue states into a corner: comply, hand over your voter data, and risk that data being used by Trump to challenge election results if the Court later strikes the rule down, or wait and risk sending ballots late or even losing the ability to send ballots at all if the Court upholds it.
The Supreme Court is now working hand-in-hand with Trump to cause chaos this November. Earlier this year, they gutted the Voting Rights Act, a decision that let red states move to eliminate Black congressional districts, delay ongoing primaries, and hand Republicans more than a dozen seats.
That's what makes this ruling so disturbing. Whether or not SCOTUS ultimately rules in favor of allowing Trump to effectively ban mail-in ballots in blue states, the damage is already done. It means Democrats are not just fighting off election rigging threats from federal agencies like the DOJ, DHS, and USPS, but the highest court in the land too.
This is why Defend Our Courts mission is now more important than ever. We are fighting on two fronts: building a firewall of state Supreme Courts that can protect free and fair elections at the state level, and building the movement to reform the Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.

body:
Who Gets to See the Voter Rolls?

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/grantdemocracy/grant-report-july-16-12774738?e=c16f400a56)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/a338f5B7vWr?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a)
| | **Who Gets to See the Voter Rolls?****By Justin Riemer, President, USGI, and Marshal Trigg, Counsel, USGI** Two federal appeals courts have now split over whether the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) lets the public inspect a state’s voter rolls.The latest case is [_Public Interest Legal Foundation v. Nago_](https://us.list-manage.com/18364HbJDB_?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a). PILF requested Hawaii’s statewide voter file under [Section 8(i)](https://us.list-manage.com/N3HkU2_y8HV?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) of the NVRA, which requires election officials to allow the public to inspect “all records concerning the implementation” of programs used to keep voter lists accurate and current. The Ninth Circuit held in April that the disclosure provision does not cover the voter file itself, but rather records that “document each step a state undertakes when actively implementing” NVRA “programs,” such as procedural manuals. PILF asked the Supreme Court to review that decision in July.The Ninth Circuit’s decision conflicts with the First Circuit’s 2024 ruling in [_PILF v. Bellows_](https://us.list-manage.com/bXu6HTzbT8J?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a). There, the court held that Maine’s voter file was subject to disclosure because it was the “output and end result” of the state’s registration and list maintenance activities. A Maryland federal district court [held the same](https://us.list-manage.com/baTd4vDC8M1?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) in 2025 in _Sullivan v. Summers_ , a case brought by Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE), adding that voter history housed in the state voter file is also covered by Section 8. Federal district courts in South Carolina, Illinois, and Mississippi have also held that Section 8 guarantees access to a state’s voter rolls. But [a federal district court in Michigan](https://us.list-manage.com/17dk5SENrxP?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) rejected these courts’ rationales and similar arguments from the Justice Department in February, reasoning that the voter list is something produced by list maintenance, not a record about how list maintenance is performed. (The Sixth Circuit affirmed in June on other grounds, without reaching the Section 8(i) question.) The Ninth Circuit adopted much the same distinction in _Nago_. On that reading, Section 8(i) reaches only officials’ documentation surrounding list maintenance, not the voter file itself.These rulings deny the public access to the record that enables it to evaluate the efficacy of list maintenance efforts: the voter file itself. States constantly add, remove, and update voter registration records. A voter file records the accumulated results of those decisions. Examining it can uncover duplicate registrations, voters who remain registered at old addresses, deceased voters’ records, and other discrepancies that warrant further investigation. Often enough the apparent problem turns out to have an innocent explanation, which is worth knowing too.Procedure documents do not answer the same questions. A manual can explain when an official is supposed to remove a voter or update his or her record. Emails may show how officials handled a particular issue. The voter file itself shows what those procedures produced, and whether officials were actually following them.Voter files are complicated, and outside groups sometimes draw dramatic conclusions from records they do not fully understand. Some of those claims rest on clerical quirks or mistaken analyses regarding the meaning of certain data within them. But secrecy is a strange remedy for that. Mistaken claims can be examined and corrected. Inaccurate and outdated records in the state’s own database, where, according to the Ninth Circuit, no one else can look, can sit there indefinitely because nothing makes the state go looking either.Congress deliberately chose broad language in Section 8: “all records concerning” the implementation of list maintenance programs. And it said why: the statute’s declared purposes include “ensur[ing] that accurate and current voter registration rolls are maintained” and “protect[ing] the integrity of the electoral process,” with public inspection as the mechanism for testing whether that is happening. Manuals and reports are records concerning implementation. So is the file those procedures produce. A voter roll reflects thousands or millions of individual decisions made in carrying out that work. Until this split is resolved, whether the public can check a state’s list maintenance work depends on which circuit the state sits in.
---

clean_body: Who Gets to See the Voter Rolls? | | | | | | | | | Who Gets to See the Voter Rolls?By Justin Riemer, President, USGI, and Marshal Trigg, Counsel, USGI Two federal appeals courts have now split over whether the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) lets the public inspect a state’s voter rolls.The latest case is . PILF requested Hawaii’s statewide voter file under of the NVRA, which requires election officials to allow the public to inspect “all records concerning the implementation” of programs used to keep voter lists accurate and current. The Ninth Circuit held in April that the disclosure provision does not cover the voter file itself, but rather records that “document each step a state undertakes when actively implementing” NVRA “programs,” such as procedural manuals. PILF asked the Supreme Court to review that decision in July.The Ninth Circuit’s decision conflicts with the First Circuit’s 2024 ruling in . There, the court held that Maine’s voter file was subject to disclosure because it was the “output and end result” of the state’s registration and list maintenance activities. A Maryland federal district court in 2025 in Sullivan v. Summers , a case brought by Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE), adding that voter history housed in the state voter file is also covered by Section 8. Federal district courts in South Carolina, Illinois, and Mississippi have also held that Section 8 guarantees access to a state’s voter rolls. But rejected these courts’ rationales and similar arguments from the Justice Department in February, reasoning that the voter list is something produced by list maintenance, not a record about how list maintenance is performed. (The Sixth Circuit affirmed in June on other grounds, without reaching the Section 8(i) question.) The Ninth Circuit adopted much the same distinction in Nago. On that reading, Section 8(i) reaches only officials’ documentation surrounding list maintenance, not the voter file itself.These rulings deny the public access to the record that enables it to evaluate the efficacy of list maintenance efforts: the voter file itself. States constantly add, remove, and update voter registration records. A voter file records the accumulated results of those decisions. Examining it can uncover duplicate registrations, voters who remain registered at old addresses, deceased voters’ records, and other discrepancies that warrant further investigation. Often enough the apparent problem turns out to have an innocent explanation, which is worth knowing too.Procedure documents do not answer the same questions. A manual can explain when an official is supposed to remove a voter or update his or her record. Emails may show how officials handled a particular issue. The voter file itself shows what those procedures produced, and whether officials were actually following them.Voter files are complicated, and outside groups sometimes draw dramatic conclusions from records they do not fully understand. Some of those claims rest on clerical quirks or mistaken analyses regarding the meaning of certain data within them. But secrecy is a strange remedy for that. Mistaken claims can be examined and corrected. Inaccurate and outdated records in the state’s own database, where, according to the Ninth Circuit, no one else can look, can sit there indefinitely because nothing makes the state go looking either.Congress deliberately chose broad language in Section 8: “all records concerning” the implementation of list maintenance programs. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal.
