Dear Fellow American, You follow our work and read my weekly messages. **But you might hesitate to make a financial gift to Judicial Watch.** **I think I know why ...** I think it may be because you share in one of two common misconceptions:
1. You doubt that a financial contribution would really make a difference to protect honest elections.
2. Or you mistakenly think Judicial Watch gets the funding we need from legal fees.

**But here is the truth:** Judicial Watch depends almost entirely on individual support from grassroots donors. **We do NOT charge our clients legal fees.** **And your gift WILL make a difference.** In fact, _none of our victories would be possible without our donors_. That's why I'm writing to ask you to _[make a gift to fund our work today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85014&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_. | [MAKE A GIFT FOR THE RULE OF LAW ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85014&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)
With the 2026 elections approaching, the radical Left is still attacking voter ID, accurate voter rolls, and other common sense election safeguards. **While others talk about this threat, Judicial Watch acts.** And thanks to the support of our donors, we keep winning.
* In January, the U.S. Supreme Court agreed with us 7-2, affirming the right of federal candidates to challenge election laws. I said then, and I will say again now: _" This is the most important Supreme Court election law ruling in a generation."_

* In April, we reached a settlement that removed 372,000 ineligible names from Colorado's voter registration lists.

* That same month, Oregon officials confirmed that 800,000 ineligible voter names are slated for review and removal under a settlement of our lawsuit.

* And today, Judicial Watch is carrying a caseload of **nearly 180 active lawsuits.**

In total, our lawsuits and legal actions have helped remove **nearly 7 million dirty names** from voter registration rolls nationwide. _No other organization in the nation is doing this crucial work to protect election integrity at this scale_. **And it 's our donors who made this record of success possible.** Now I'm asking you to _[join them with a gift](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85014&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_. _Because every lawsuit, investigation, records request, or voter-roll analysis comes with very real costs._ **_[Please make your tax-deductible gift today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85014&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_ to keep Judicial Watch fighting for honest elections, government transparency, and the rule of law.** | [MAKE A GIFT NOW ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85014&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)
When we look around at the challenges facing our country, it's clear **Judicial Watch 's _independent_ watchdog work is needed more than ever.** **And I hope it 's clear just how much Judicial Watch's work needs YOU.** So, if you value our efforts to uphold the rule of law, fight for honest elections, and hold corrupt politicians and bureaucrats accountable, please honor our fight by _[making a gift today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85014&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_. Because with you on our team, I know we can keep winning. Sincerely, Tom Fitton
President, Judicial Watch P.S. The results speak for themselves: **our lawsuits and other legal efforts have caused the removal of nearly 7 million dirty names** from voter registration rolls. But that expensive work was **__only__** possible through supporter contributions. **Your gift WILL matter and it WILL make an impact.**_[Please join our fight with a tax-deductible contribution today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85014&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)_. | [MAKE A GIFT FOR HONEST ELECTIONS ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85014&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)

body:

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=161291625bf44964816ac51e512fa202&_e=vCPAvjHYiysEEoHduT0prBMPb5RMX8Iui_BX_ZAxbioXqekSYGINWPLcSoyi-lB-kOuM2X1ZZcF-rmXSYI9J1xUX0l3WH1lnvdWt8TaH0hITzxo-Be_ZIB-kVgKFK-AUSBbCXJpfeJOtwRl7fRj4ZDplCXEaA7BvpNgufEpNr7bbvyZeCyxpscmxwsxQSu-M295UsNSMxM5EfwNZ0xy7Zm9zgr1KcdG0-R9FQVJQHJqNHPvBf4KVCLUZgf14LEFM8mwPUxL290UmSA_vVtbQs1xMLxP2DrlfO-4ZmdterNlisyMah_iPgJA1ZWiBrs0ha0I_lb2twq5cxigCZZWlzFx-mp8gf5LlTSusbE4IcEGdiPfZhrKJBK_T9-mHr_6aI7lQPsRlxHQUT-Y3vd2RpFm5XuM8sfuAIk8dhSpMJITCMCw_FEHVloLJXmYWh5_yGS5Uf5mzdjtZwiFRykcA5GJGNl0LsbU5rLJh2rgfeE3eQ_YmtSesVL99-Sf4fc0DYz5P9qR15akQ9591QOlibxLSmVdWoh7q-mHQD81ufDHKkrXE-fANJoks31iXe5nu_ZGWGdoSAovedUulQWB7sGcWWTjYOBhOW0zJ5QUy3RjvcGZ7i67nPGMwqrFZfw35Q6RIihqickxMjsa2zlSf0hlDI_zTStPHvRtGqzLEhFFyGlpo_jJ2ex4gY8clG6NigvqkcDdg8uH8fWYX1JJZRLcT3mIlXwvN71eAhwS9D6zmFpcxRkmm99mpsXqQY4KQ3IvFscDaSbIXzNDZ1YnA9GngsfAm1cnqvssKUJ_94Fw%3D)

Thank you, Fellow Patriot.

It's been a long six weeks, but because you were by my side, _we won._

Your generosity helped us through the Special Election Primary and through a head-to-head runoff.

**But that was just the first step to securing this seat.**

I am the first woman United States senator in South Carolina history. My Democratic opponent, Dr. Annie Andrews, cannot be the second.

Here's where the race stands. Two statewide elections in less than 6 weeks were expensive. We knew it would be a tough battle - it was.

We did not want to leave anything to chance, so we had to ensure every dollar we raised was well spent on television ads, voter contacts, and signs across South Carolina.

**[Our campaign coffers are empty after a well-fought battle.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=161291625bf44964816ac51e512fa202&_e=vCPAvjHYiysEEoHduT0prBMPb5RMX8Iui_BX_ZAxbioXqekSYGINWPLcSoyi-lB-kOuM2X1ZZcF-rmXSYI9J1xUX0l3WH1lnvdWt8TaH0hITzxo-Be_ZIB-kVgKFK-AUSBbCXJpfeJOtwRl7fRj4ZDplCXEaA7BvpNgufEpNr7bbvyZeCyxpscmxwsxQSu-M295UsNSMxM5EfwNZ0xy7Zm9zgr1KcdG0-R9FQVJQHJqNHPvBf4KVCLUZgf14LEFM8mwPUxL290UmSA_vVtbQs1xMLxP2DrlfO-4ZmdterNmI8TEbp1pSk5hsfWBq-RQZRxMjbHWgOeOgqLrhozf5RD93RiXs52saiCHiZ20ZmnEjmVi_UPbS60iwDESyYCbkMshW0kUZ_x2hBZKC3L3N6o1Pm_HCeo-KGQp8J4yedq0DXhVpk5h2im5k-lJScH2lMDK87yKMfFCld41mSH_-9oTgRht3-FAMt_M5kNcm2cn-Tdb0-9tXxgDj5EJDHVxGssS3YBZBiyhhJyU_bosAjRHN4FH-S4wpTRt9XHCw_P2FkCi6fEcMbzqKt4WY5FB98inLYB8sFu2IYCNfM_7vlAE5_SpTH77uuurBV6BQAPdrLUBiM3JjUVczsTEw6Bab3ZMdEQMRbnHrmXsRZ-FZFJYZRfgkyluZ3sY7xIhDtJwu0uXPJVjKKw-_xmGgNGkZ7u-nFZ-9p-n9giq6Y8nQjIt2S_fvBrBp5E3ZCZk0Zhd74H2mTkl2aVZRAwCnGIRRLeMW-_X5K1LRkPG8ra6QZUNBnMzj3KLUA0E6RdUQygQ%3D)**

We are starting at square one, going into the general election, and let me tell you about our Democrat opponent. She's raising millions from liberal donors who want nothing more than to flip this seat and stop President Trump's agenda in Washington.

_**I need your help again, Fellow Patriot.**_

Vice President J.D. Vance addresses a crowd of GOP supporters in Brewer, Maine, Aug. 24, 2026 (Photo: TheMaineWire.com)
Vice President J.D. Vance's second visit to Maine, which followed closely on the heels of a visit from Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Administrator Dr. Mehmet Oz, has signaled that Maine is a top priority not only for 2026 political campaigns, but also for the Trump administration's ongoing war on welfare fraud.
Yet for all the reporting of Medicaid moguls abusing disabled Mainers while driving luxury vehicles and seemingly non-existent home health care businesses earning millions of dollars, none of Maine's fraudsters have been arrested or charged.
So what gives?
An individual familiar with the U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of Maine, who asked to speak anonymously because they were not authorized to talk with the media, told me at least seven major welfare-fraud investigations are on hold because of resource and manpower constraints. The source said the volume of potential fraud matters -- including cases involving transnational criminal organizations -- has overwhelmed the small federal office.
"We're starting from scratch with an understaffed office, a state attorney general who has prosecuted no new cases of fraud, and a state government that has turned a blind eye to unprecedented levels of welfare fraud and organized crime for eight years," the source said.
The source did not identify the seven investigations or provide case numbers, and their status cannot be independently verified from the information supplied.
The source's description of the office recently inherited by U.S. Attorney Andrew Benson, appointed by President Trump earlier this year, aligns not only with the noticeable absence of enforcement activity out of Maine, but also with recent federal audits, Medicaid suspension lists, the government's own billing data, and the Maine Wire's exhaustive investigative reporting into the abuse of Maine's largest welfare program.
### The Federal Medicaid Data Makes Fraud Trivial to Find
Last year, the Maine Wire acquired and published state data showing annual payments to Maine's Medicaid providers. In January, though, the Trump administration took the unprecedented step of releasing granular, monthly claims-level data that allowed for the most detailed-ever look at how America's trillion-dollar welfare program operates. That dataset, in combination with new AI/LLM tools, allows for a level of scrutiny that has never been possible when combing billing records with Microsoft Excel or QuickBooks.
Among the many newly available tactics that government officials and curious journalists can use to identify potentially fraudulent Medicaid businesses is the ability to hunt for extreme mathematical outliers and anomalies. For example, using the federal dataset, we can compare how much home health care and autism care providers in Maine are charging in comparison to their peers nationally or just in New England.
The results are devastating for any Mainer interested in fiscal responsibility.
In almost every possible corner of the Medicaid program, Maine pays far more than the national median for the exact same health care services. In some cases, Maine pays twice as much or even five times as much, and these extra costs add up to hundreds of millions of dollars that are coming out of taxpayers' pockets. And, in cases where the claims are fraudulent, the money isn't even going toward the health care of poor Mainers.
Federal Medicaid billing data shows spending on personal-care services in Maine -- the service provided by all the stupidly named "home health care agencies" that we find stacked atop each other in empty office buildings -- rose from $42.6 million in 2018 to $116.4 million in 2024, a 173 percent increase, even as the number of people receiving care grew by roughly 28 percent, from 2,488 to 3,192. Home health agency payments more than doubled over the same span, from $26.5 million to $67.2 million. Residential care for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities, the category that includes the autism group homes at the center of the scandal, climbed from $204 million to more than $300 million a year, even as the population of people using MaineCare Section 21 services remained mostly flat.
Much of the increased cost of personal care services and autism group homes may be attributed to changes that Democratic lawmakers and Gov. Janet Mills made not only to expand Medicaid eligibility, but also to jack up the legislated cost of a given service. But changes in the Medicaid payment rules can't explain the extreme cost of Medicaid in Maine entirely. ### The U.S. Attorney of Maine Under Biden Did Nothing on Systemic Medicaid Fraud
To be clear, the extreme outlier status and laughably high billing rates associated with these MaineCare start-ups don't equate to fraud. But they certainly provide a clue that, in concert with abundant other evidence -- such as frequent police reports involving homes run by these companies -- might pique the curiosity of former U.S. Attorney Darcie McElwee or one of her ambitious prosecutors. But that never happened. Instead, what meager cases the office took in relation to benefits fraud involved individuals lying about their income to enroll in benefits programs -- a world of fraud that is several orders of magnitude smaller than provider-side fraud.
The absence of prosecutions from 2020 to 2024 occurred during the same time period in which a federal audit of a single MaineCare program -- Section 28 children's autism services -- found $45.6 million in improper payments in 2023 alone, with every sampled claim containing errors. The state has since suspended one of the Section 28 providers, Gateway Community Services, but Attorney General Aaron Frey has yet to announce any charges against the offenders, and the Mills administration has brushed aside the audit finding as a political attack on her stillborn U.S. Senate campaign.

## The Clock Is Ticking
Andrew B. Benson has served as U.S. Attorney since October 2025 and was confirmed by the Senate in May. It would be unfair to pin every unresolved allegation from the Mills years on a prosecutor who arrived late in the cycle. Unlike Benson's colleague in the District of Massachusetts, Leah Foley, Benson hasn't inherited a slate of cases awaiting the green light to move forward. As the source familiar with the U.S. Attorney's Office said, everything is starting from scratch.
But Benson now owns the federal charging decisions, the priorities, and the public test of whether the Trump administration's fraud task force will amount to more than speeches and spreadsheets. Vice President J.D. Vance came to Bangor in May to praise _The Maine Wire_ 's reporting and announce an aggressive crackdown on fraud. Dr. Oz walked the grounds of Paradise Residential with _Maine Wire_ reporter Jon Fetherston and gave every indication that the federal government is serious about hunting down the fraudsters, holding them accountable, and returning purloined funds to the American taxpayer.
So what is the federal government's next move?
The anonymous source said the office could "quintuple" the lawyers and investigators working on fraud and racketeering matters and still have everyone working overtime. That's a plea to the White House Fraud Task Force and Executive Director Scott Brady, as well as federal law enforcement agencies, for more manpower and more resources to tackle the caseload that Maine's U.S. Attorney's Office can't handle as it is presently constituted.
It's a message, too, for Maine's congressional delegation, the Justice Department, and the White House. They should answer plainly: When will the cavalry arrive to stop the open and gross pillaging of the Maine taxpayer?
Maine does not need a new slogan about fraud or another visit from a famous politician. It needs named defendants, indictments where the evidence warrants them, trials where defendants contest the charges, restitution orders that put money back into the programs that were allegedly exploited, seized properties, and -- above all else -- some seized Mercedes-Benz G-Wagons.
And, for what it's worth, a couple of G-Wagons for the reporting team who's been flagging all of this Medicaid fraud would probably be appropriate.

Legends Residential Care LLC: Billing a total of $34.7 million annually, Legends Residential Care earned 2.13x the national median for T2016, or roughly $29,519 per patient per month. At two patients per residential home, that worked out to approximately $708,456 in Medicaid payments per home annually. Legends obtained its NPI in March 2022 and first billed Medicaid in 2022 (first state payment 2022; first federal claim August 2022). Coastal Community Care LLC: Billing a total of $7.6 million annually, Coastal Community Care earned 2.03x the national median for T2016, or roughly $28,108 per patient per month. At two patients per residential home, that worked out to approximately $674,592 in Medicaid payments per home annually. Coastal obtained its NPI in July 2019, first appears in state payment records in 2019, and first billed under T2016 in federal claims in January 2021. Northeast Residential Services: Billing a total of $9.0 million annually, Northeast Residential Services earned 1.96x the national median for T2016, or roughly $27,094 per patient per month. At two patients per residential home, that worked out to approximately $650,256 in Medicaid payments per home annually. Northeast obtained its NPI in May 2018, first appears in state payment records in 2019, and first billed under T2016 in federal claims in May 2021. Maine Family Services LLC: Billing a total of $6.3 million annually, Maine Family Services earned 1.92x the national median for T2016, or roughly $26,527 per patient per month. At two patients per residential home, that worked out to approximately $636,648 in Medicaid payments per home annually. Maine Family Services obtained its NPI in February 2017, first appears in state payment records in 2019, and first billed under T2016 in federal claims in July 2020. The U.S. Attorney of Maine Under Biden Did Nothing on Systemic Medicaid Fraud To be clear, the extreme outlier status and laughably high billing rates associated with these MaineCare start-ups don't equate to fraud. But they certainly provide a clue that, in concert with abundant other evidence -- such as frequent police reports involving homes run by these companies -- might pique the curiosity of former U.S. Attorney Darcie McElwee or one of her ambitious prosecutors. But that never happened. Instead, what meager cases the office took in relation to benefits fraud involved individuals lying about their income to enroll in benefits programs -- a world of fraud that is several orders of magnitude smaller than provider-side fraud. The absence of prosecutions from 2020 to 2024 occurred during the same time period in which a federal audit of a single MaineCare program -- Section 28 children's autism services -- found $45.6 million in improper payments in 2023 alone, with every sampled claim containing errors. The state has since suspended one of the Section 28 providers, Gateway Community Services, but Attorney General Aaron Frey has yet to announce any charges against the offenders, and the Mills administration has brushed aside the audit finding as a political attack on her stillborn U.S. Senate campaign. The Clock Is Ticking Andrew B. Benson has served as U.S. Attorney since October 2025 and was confirmed by the Senate in May. It would be unfair to pin every unresolved allegation from the Mills years on a prosecutor who arrived late in the cycle. Unlike Benson's colleague in the District of Massachusetts, Leah Foley, Benson hasn't inherited a slate of cases awaiting the green light to move forward. As the source familiar with the U.S. Attorney's Office said, everything is starting from scratch. But Benson now owns the federal charging decisions, the priorities, and the public test of whether the Trump administration's fraud task force will amount to more than speeches and spreadsheets. Vice President J.D. Vance came to Bangor in May to praise The Maine Wire 's reporting and announce an aggressive crackdown on fraud. Dr. Oz walked the grounds of Paradise Residential with Maine Wire reporter Jon Fetherston and gave every indication that the federal government is serious about hunting down the fraudsters, holding them accountable, and returning purloined funds to the American taxpayer. So what is the federal government's next move? The anonymous source said the office could "quintuple" the lawyers and investigators working on fraud and racketeering matters and still have everyone working overtime. That's a plea to the White House Fraud Task Force and Executive Director Scott Brady, as well as federal law enforcement agencies, for more manpower and more resources to tackle the caseload that Maine's U.S. Attorney's Office can't handle as it is presently constituted. It's a message, too, for Maine's congressional delegation, the Justice Department, and the White House. They should answer plainly: When will the cavalry arrive to stop the open and gross pillaging of the Maine taxpayer? Maine does not need a new slogan about fraud or another visit from a famous politician. It needs named defendants, indictments where the evidence warrants them, trials where defendants contest the charges, restitution orders that put money back into the programs that were allegedly exploited, seized properties, and -- above all else -- some seized Mercedes-Benz G-Wagons. And, for what it's worth, a couple of G-Wagons for the reporting team who's been flagging all of this Medicaid fraud would probably be appropriate. You 're receiving The Robinson Report for free. name: Office of the Governor
subject: How We’ve Delivered for Marylanders This Month
body:
Good news for Maryland!
---
| | | | |
---
| My fellow Marylanders, August has been a busy and productive month for our administration, and I wanted to take a moment to share some of what we’ve been able to deliver for Marylanders all across the state. We kept investing in the people who make Maryland run with our [**Grow Your Own Educators grants**](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2Fgovernor-moore-announces-147-million-grow-your-own-educators-grants-supporting-845-educators/1/010001a044356887-41aeb703-a08d-49fd-805f-9bc4a7ff1298-000000/LyJFjAhx26NiGkQd84ebr6ahgrsvAcoHqyzTgMg4bQc=452)**, which will support over 800 educators across the state** – and we announced the [Maryland Pay It Forward Fund](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2Fstate-maryland-and-social-finance-announce-maryland-pay-it-forward-fund/1/010001a044356887-41aeb703-a08d-49fd-805f-9bc4a7ff1298-000000/0_d5U45crPT8Hc-hJSNkHSt_LJAB39zJytttcrMc4eM=452), a partnership with Social Finance to support aspiring nurses at a time when our hospitals and communities critically needs them. Building on that action on health care, we awarded **$80 million in grant funding across 41 grantees for the first year of our**[**Rural Health Transformation Program**](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2Fmaryland-department-health-announces-80-million-first-round-rural-health-transformation/1/010001a044356887-41aeb703-a08d-49fd-805f-9bc4a7ff1298-000000/qhsPwGBM13ns8cj7XPK_D94ifPzycDUDMxDdfugHzYw=452) to strengthen and expand access to primary care, behavioral health care and dental services. The program also helps to improve the quality of care delivered and reduce costs to the overall healthcare system. When it comes to affordability, we’re continuing our push to confront rising energy costs through a [**landmark solar energy agreement**](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2Fmaryland-announces-landmark-solar-energy-agreement-expected-save-300-million-while-advancing-cle/1/010001a044356887-41aeb703-a08d-49fd-805f-9bc4a7ff1298-000000/WDyTK43fHuPi2mcGSmBrL48W0vwi9FDq8kfBlgppFP8=452)**that’s expected to save our state between $298 and $515 million over the next 20 years** – while also advancing our clean energy goals. Our Maryland Insurance Administration also recovered [**more than $53 million for consumers**](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2Fgovernor-moore-announces-more-535-million-recovered-maryland-insurance-administration/1/010001a044356887-41aeb703-a08d-49fd-805f-9bc4a7ff1298-000000/fsbh2FWi43EGj7p_kDDjh0kGTYKsBafJ8BHW4EoTWxw=452) in the first half of 2026 alone. And just days ago, we rolled out [**new fraud-resistant EBT cards**](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Freel%2F981119264987366/1/010001a044356887-41aeb703-a08d-49fd-805f-9bc4a7ff1298-000000/EZEFZtk8Qaq86Mw_Bb01IXTbzjjAWKYskVYmitVzAsU=452) so Maryland families who rely on food assistance can trust that their benefits are protected. Rounding out all these incredible wins, **we secured a**[**major legal victory**](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2Fgovernor-moore-statement-maryland-victory-fbi-headquarters-lawsuit/1/010001a044356887-41aeb703-a08d-49fd-805f-9bc4a7ff1298-000000/j6dxR3oTreapWikpsjyIXSmp0dtG4hVNrue3-j2PNOc=452)**against the Trump-Vance Administration** after the U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland ruled in favor of Maryland and blocked their unlawful attempt to move the FBI headquarters away from the Greenbelt site. Thank you for continuing to do your part in showing up for Maryland, no matter where you live. Your Governor,
Wes Moore

name: Jen Kiggans
subject: Blossom
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
People often ask...how did I get that name?

| [](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.-k4rTiGQ)
---
That’s a picture of me from when I flew H-46 and H-3 helicopters in the U.S. Navy. If you look to my left, you can see my call sign...**Blossom.**
People often ask...how did I get that name?
Well, my roommate in flight school and I went on a bit of a “girl power” kick one day and bought old bathtub non-skid flower stickers from the store, cut out that flower shape in reflective tape from our squadron, and stuck those reflective flowers on our helmets.
There is very little room for making a Navy flight suit more “feminine,” but on cruise we were able to be a little more creative and came to love those girly flowers on our helmets.
Although the helicopter community doesn’t use call signs as much as some of the fixed wing squadrons, the “Blossom” stuck and was painted on the side of a CH-46 for part of my first cruise. Made for a great photo and story!
It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me the importance of service.
Far too often, our elected officials today forget that their job is to SERVE. They think it is their job to tell everyone what to do and why everyone else is wrong....but that’s not service.
As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community.
**While for some it is all about power, for me it is all about service.**
Sadly, this has made me some enemies in Washington.
No one is going to buy me off or tell me what to do...I’m going to keep serving the people I represent, not serve some “master” in Washington, D.C.
If you are also tired of leaders who care more about power than service, [I’m asking you to send me some help today.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._jqMi4yYWw)
Because I’m a veteran and not a career politician, I need all the help I can get to support my fight against the Democrats.
---
| [RUSH SUPPORT TO JEN](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.-pkuUUHur0aYvG70C6hLw)
---
I know this was a longer message than you are probably used to getting, but I want you to know where I’m coming from and why I need your help. Whether it’s $100 or just $10, anything you can contribute will help this Navy veteran keep fighting back business as usual in D.C.
It’s time we support leaders who truly want to serve our country, and that’s what I promise to always do...are you with me, Peter?
With the courage to fight,
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
-Jen
---
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America’s success!
---
| [SUPPORT JEN KIGGANS](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
| Paid for by Kiggans for Congress

Specifically, I'm asking you to sign the "Schools Need a Bible Revival" petition and tell your Governor that the children in your community deserve to hear that: They are wonderfully ma | | | | | Dear Friend, Will you help me put God back in your town schools? Specifically, I'm asking you to sign the "[**Schools Need a Bible Revival**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODF9AAwAAAAAAprNSPZmDEketn9wtzMSgRk98-yeHg7HBCD7T347SSzRopkqjcqBmKgpoyWU_Z5jd_DJtseXokVsJBsW-sc4_nMMXQj2alZvs6YklpqZlw)" petition and tell your Governor that the children in your community deserve to hear that: They are wonderfully made in the very image of God. And that God is calling them to love Him above all else. What a country we'd be, if all of America's children had just a little bit of God's Word in their lives - like you did. But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. **And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family.** It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools. **[That's why I'm spearheading a nationwide Bible Revival in public schools and asking you to join me today. ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODF9AAwAAAAAAprNSPZnV6iebihmr27cIJ4Cchklo2gbGbnz5bI5V0O-9OK7vOXtYzgnpK0vreK5dFfvuY66DoaUtg9-pzJfV6RzpKGNiCb7W74O3sVM4A)** Your signature on your "[**Schools Need a Bible Revival**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODF9AAwAAAAAAprNSPZoRtFeoSYfP-B9mJ4z4lXZ9BpW5gR7X-G25T50XdZCJcbVID2fU0YKRkS4XzxDjj2bL561aXkSzPTc15wc7RHIVIAdlWJY4d18DQ)" petition tells our representatives that you want biblical lessons put back in schools. Your signed "**[Schools Need a Bible Revival](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODF9AAwAAAAAAprNSPZpcE0rifkSCLXTQyKDlijmT97h4jyRAolZnTu16aDO1sPsYfUaefGk6l9u9PQ8RvlOpknxlkYo7EmrwjHKFTg2S1WEzUh0Roq9kA)** " petition is going straight to my friends at **BRAVE FOR GOOD**. **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group behind my "See You at the Library" movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left's "Drag Queen Story Hours." **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year! And **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish - and that America was founded upon - **back into public schools this year!** HOW? When I got off active duty and came back home to the great state of Georgia, I quickly realized that despite having thousands of service members in our communities, **_Georgia is not a veteran-friendly state,_** between state taxes on military retirement and a healthcare system that treats veterans like an afterthought.
---
| [ ](http://clicksp.shawnharrisforcongress.com/f/a/waTiRecyQVGEa_E-hhEb4g~~/AAPPABA~/6b21Z_msU60dOEUw91i7nOAmohYg1kqp0O3fWU-rDh1z9QiLH_1ZFr547ROp582EAS90nLscZUkuzmyL3NUtHrkZTYmBgfphXVrzWhqxpSoMAcEFRoQPmwnPyoU86zIIVkHa1dPOlUi2k6ZP5pSyEg1BfDX1RqlRlhV4U2gqaVqgUHmpaqDdGJrzQmt4GziKqWv9-AZbuGXY-l1VUL-nh4INhbtFNaOExA1bdAsCX8tTGewW1b8UWKkCtsm5CygfoO2VXDznW890rwRbgd4rXOCXXZM5MyUNzis59Ow9uGEnd1XXnFeWOOm3AkTo5Afm)
---
My last assignment was in Israel. I went from leading troops in high-stakes environments to coming back home and experiencing the sudden crash that so many service members face when transitioning back to civilian life. I knew I needed help, so I called Fort Benning. They directed me to a local mental health facility. I pulled up to that clinic as General Shawn Harris. I walked to the counter, and the receptionist looked right at me and said: _"We don't take TRICARE anymore."_ I had served 40 years. I had the rank, and I had the phone numbers to call people high up in the chain of command to fix my situation. But what if I was an E-4? If a young Specialist walked into that clinic without a star on their shoulder or a direct line to a general, they would have been turned away with nowhere to go. Without help, they could have ended up dead. I walked back out, sat in my car, and thought: **_This is why I 'm getting into politics._** **My blood boils when politicians like Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth treat our military like a political backdrop or talk about veterans' benefits as something to slash and privatize.** Pete Hegseth and the political class in Washington love to wrap themselves in the flag, but when our service members come home broken, struggling, or needing care, they look the other way. They treat the men and women who put their lives on the line like line items on a spreadsheet instead of human beings who earned their care. Our troops and veterans don't need political posturing or lectures on culture wars from political appointees--they need a healthcare system that actually answers the phone when they call for help. I fought for this country for four decades, and I'm not going to sit quietly while politicians neglect the men and women who served alongside me. # [Nvidia jumps 7% after guiding for 70% growth into 2028](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia shares jumped 7.2% in premarket trading Thursday after the chipmaker's fiscal 2028 outlook reassured investors that artificial intelligence demand will stay strong despite supply constraints.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Fiscal 2028 guidance:** Nvidia expects 70% revenue growth for fiscal 2028, though CEO Jensen Huang said demand is much greater and supply is constrained.
* **Enterprise mix expands:** AI Clouds, industrial and enterprise customers generated $40.3 billion in quarterly sales, up 138% from a year earlier.
* **Chip peers rally:** Micron rose 4.5%, Marvell 5.7% and Arm 4.7% as investors treated the report as a lift for the wider AI hardware group.
* **Custom silicon risk:** Analysts said custom chips from hyperscalers and labs such as OpenAI could challenge Nvidia's grip on the most advanced AI processors.

# [$12.9 billion for a $150 million company. Nvidia wants the models.](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia has agreed to buy open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, The Information reported, a deal that would push the chipmaker deeper into software and models.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Talks now confirmed:** A source familiar with the matter told CNBC that an acquisition by Nvidia has been part of ongoing and recent talks.
* **No official comment:** Neither Nvidia nor Hugging Face immediately responded to CNBC requests for comment on the reported $12.9 billion agreement.
* **Stack strategy fits:** Fund manager Siddy Jobe said Hugging Face matches Nvidia's platform approach across energy, foundational models and applications.
* **Security backdrop lingers:** Hugging Face recently faced a hacking incident that CEO Clement Delangue blamed on engineering mistakes, not a strategy shift.

# [Alphabet just erased $692 billion. Google's AI crown is slipping.](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Alphabet has erased $692 billion in market value since its May 13 peak, as investors question a talent drain at Google's parent and whether the company is losing its edge in AI.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Reversal after surge:** Shares had soared more than 150% in the prior 12 months before falling 15% from the high and becoming a top drag on the S&P 500.
* **Gemini delay weighs:** Heavy AI infrastructure spending and the delayed release of Alphabet's new Gemini model have pressured sentiment around the stock.
* **Leadership exits sting:** Jeff Dean left to start a company and Demis Hassabis stepped down as DeepMind CEO, helping send shares down 4% on August 5.
* **Talent war spreads:** The selloff follows earlier losses of two top Google employees to Anthropic and OpenAI as Big Tech's AI hiring fight intensifies.

# [Meta's $16.7B deal dodged a $1.4 trillion verdict. For now.](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meta's $16.7 billion settlement with 51 attorneys general over social media addiction does not end the company's legal exposure, California AG Rob Bonta said Wednesday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Floor not ceiling:** Bonta said the deal is not preemptive and called it a floor conceptually, not a ceiling, as other cases keep moving.
* **Teen product changes:** Meta must add daily usage limits, nighttime blocks for teenagers, enhanced age checks and more tools for parents and guardians.
* **Payout stretched out:** Participating states are slated to receive about $12.7 billion over 10 years, with $5.3 billion possibly coming from YouTube and TikTok.
* **Other cases proceed:** Florida and school-district plaintiffs are still pursuing claims, and Texas separately agreed to a $1 billion payment outside the group deal.

# [OpenAI lost 14 executives in 2026. The IPO clock is still ticking.](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OpenAI has lost 14 senior leaders in 2026, including chief revenue officer Denise Dresser, former operating chief Brad Lightcap and applications CEO Fidji Simo.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Revenue chief exits:** Dresser is leaving after joining in December 2025 to pursue other opportunities, and Dali Rajic will take over the chief revenue officer role.
* **Lightcap starts fresh:** The 2018 hire, who served as CFO then COO, said in August he is leaving to start something new while still backing OpenAI's mission.
* **Simo cites health:** The applications CEO stepped down in July to a part-time advisor role after medical leave for postural tachycardia syndrome diagnosed in 2019.
* **Wider bench thins:** Departures also hit marketing, enterprise products, science, safety and ethics, after another year of senior turnover in 2025.

# [Bragg, Hood, Drum: the Army's $2.2B nuclear break from the grid](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The U.S. Army selected five companies for awards of up to $2.2 billion to own, build and operate nuclear microreactors at five bases, targeting operations by September 2028.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Five sites named:** Reactors are slated for Fort Bragg, Fort Campbell, Fort Hood, Fort Benning and Fort Drum under the Army's Janus Program.
* **Vendors locked in:** Antares, BWXT, General Atomics, Radiant and Westinghouse will build the first units, with more than 20 reactors expected later.
* **Milestone payments only:** Funding runs from fiscal 2027 through 2031 and is paid only after companies hit specified technical goals, plus private capital.
* **Grid risk is the point:** Army Secretary Dan Driscoll said the push is meant to power installations without relying on potentially vulnerable external grids.

# [The XLR just gave American routes a 777 could never justify](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
American Airlines said Thursday it will add 7 international routes to its 2027 schedule, using Airbus A321XLR jets to reach smaller European cities more cheaply than widebodies.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5996db78-fc74-46fa-82aa-735ef1d8e9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New city pairings:** Additions include Charlotte-Barcelona, Chicago-Tokyo Narita, JFK-Amsterdam, JFK-Nice, Philadelphia-Porto, Philadelphia-Reykjavik and Philadelphia-Vienna.
* **XLR range advantage:** The extra-long-range Airbus can fly up to 4,700 nautical miles, letting a single-aisle jet serve markets too small for a 777 or 787.
* **Premium cabin push:** American gives premium seats about a fifth of the XLR cabin and plans to use the jet from Philadelphia and New York to smaller European cities.
* **London frequency grows:** The airline is also adding a fourth daily JFK-London Heathrow flight on a Boeing 787-9 starting March 28.

Custom silicon risk: Analysts said custom chips from hyperscalers and labs such as OpenAI could challenge Nvidia's grip on the most advanced AI processors. The odds of Tesla merging with SpaceX before 2028 have surged according to the latest data from Kalshi. | | ---|---|--- Elon 's Mega Corp: Elon Musk, fresh off the back of the SpaceX IPO has been rumored to be debating the move. A Pattern Emerging: Prior to the SpaceX IPO several of Musk's ventures were brought in under the SpaceX umbrella. This included the satellite internet division Starlink and the xAI division which runs the AI model Grok. | | ---|---|--- Do you think Tesla will be acquired by SpaceX? Get $25 in credit on Kalshi after you sign up using our code "brawl" or by Nvidia has agreed to buy open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, The Information reported, a deal that would push the chipmaker deeper into software and models. | | ---|---|--- Talks now confirmed: A source familiar with the matter told CNBC that an acquisition by Nvidia has been part of ongoing and recent talks. No official comment: Neither Nvidia nor Hugging Face immediately responded to CNBC requests for comment on the reported $12.9 billion agreement. Stack strategy fits: Fund manager Siddy Jobe said Hugging Face matches Nvidia's platform approach across energy, foundational models and applications. Security backdrop lingers: Hugging Face recently faced a hacking incident that CEO Clement Delangue blamed on engineering mistakes, not a strategy shift. Alphabet has erased $692 billion in market value since its May 13 peak, as investors question a talent drain at Google's parent and whether the company is losing its edge in AI. | | ---|---|--- Reversal after surge: Shares had soared more than 150% in the prior 12 months before falling 15% from the high and becoming a top drag on the S&P 500. Gemini delay weighs: Heavy AI infrastructure spending and the delayed release of Alphabet's new Gemini model have pressured sentiment around the stock. Leadership exits sting: Jeff Dean left to start a company and Demis Hassabis stepped down as DeepMind CEO, helping send shares down 4% on August 5. Talent war spreads: The selloff follows earlier losses of two top Google employees to Anthropic and OpenAI as Big Tech's AI hiring fight intensifies. | | | | ---|---|--- | Aug 16 | Meta's $16.7 billion settlement with 51 attorneys general over social media addiction does not end the company's legal exposure, California AG Rob Bonta said Wednesday. | | ---|---|--- Floor not ceiling: Bonta said the deal is not preemptive and called it a floor conceptually, not a ceiling, as other cases keep moving. Teen product changes: Meta must add daily usage limits, nighttime blocks for teenagers, enhanced age checks and more tools for parents and guardians. Payout stretched out: Participating states are slated to receive about $12.7 billion over 10 years, with $5.3 billion possibly coming from YouTube and TikTok. Other cases proceed: Florida and school-district plaintiffs are still pursuing claims, and Texas separately agreed to a $1 billion payment outside the group deal. OpenAI has lost 14 senior leaders in 2026, including chief revenue officer Denise Dresser, former operating chief Brad Lightcap and applications CEO Fidji Simo. | | ---|---|--- Revenue chief exits: Dresser is leaving after joining in December 2025 to pursue other opportunities, and Dali Rajic will take over the chief revenue officer role. Lightcap starts fresh: The 2018 hire, who served as CFO then COO, said in August he is leaving to start something new while still backing OpenAI's mission. Simo cites health: The applications CEO stepped down in July to a part-time advisor role after medical leave for postural tachycardia syndrome diagnosed in 2019. Wider bench thins: Departures also hit marketing, enterprise products, science, safety and ethics, after another year of senior turnover in 2025. The U.S. Army selected five companies for awards of up to $2.2 billion to own, build and operate nuclear microreactors at five bases, targeting operations by September 2028. | | ---|---|--- Five sites named: Reactors are slated for Fort Bragg, Fort Campbell, Fort Hood, Fort Benning and Fort Drum under the Army's Janus Program. Vendors locked in: Antares, BWXT, General Atomics, Radiant and Westinghouse will build the first units, with more than 20 reactors expected later. Milestone payments only: Funding runs from fiscal 2027 through 2031 and is paid only after companies hit specified technical goals, plus private capital. Grid risk is the point: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll said the push is meant to power installations without relying on potentially vulnerable external grids. American Airlines said Thursday it will add 7 international routes to its 2027 schedule, using Airbus A321XLR jets to reach smaller European cities more cheaply than widebodies. | | ---|---|--- New city pairings: Additions include Charlotte-Barcelona, Chicago-Tokyo Narita, JFK-Amsterdam, JFK-Nice, Philadelphia-Porto, Philadelphia-Reykjavik and Philadelphia-Vienna. XLR range advantage: The extra-long-range Airbus can fly up to 4,700 nautical miles, letting a single-aisle jet serve markets too small for a 777 or 787. Premium cabin push: American gives premium seats about a fifth of the XLR cabin and plans to use the jet from Philadelphia and New York to smaller European cities. London frequency grows: The airline is also adding a fourth daily JFK-London Heathrow flight on a Boeing 787-9 starting March 28. body:
I have to tell you something, Peter.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)

Hi Peter,
I’m on the road to our next event, and I have to tell you something:
**Three new polls have now put us within ONE point of Greg Abbott.**
And honestly, that feels a lot like what I’ve been hearing on the road. Texans are ready for a change.
I’ve heard it in Brownsville. I’ve heard it in Austin. I’ve heard it in Amarillo. And now we’re seeing it in the numbers, too.
But a close poll isn’t a victory. It’s a challenge to work even harder.
That’s why I’m going to keep putting every ounce of energy I have into this campaign, talking to voters in every corner of Texas.
Abbott has $67 million behind him. I have something better: a grassroots movement that’s willing to show up.
**[Peter, will you pitch in $5 or anything you can right now to keep me on the road?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260827_2_road.UjBQFm&refcode=em20260827-1940&amount=5&t=2&akid=1940%2E299639%2EFgC2Nm)**

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. Friend, Every Tennessee family deserves to know that their local public school is equipped to prepare their children for the future _so they can thrive and achieve their dreams._ When it comes to the future of Tennessee schools,_the path forward depends entirely on who sits in the Governor's office._ According to a recently released 2026-27 TISA Allocations report, Under Governor Bill Lee, traditional K-12 public school students are receiving significantly less investment per pupil compared to the financial allocations directed toward private voucher programs. This November, the choice for Tennesseans comes down to _a clear difference in priorities:_ _**Do we invest directly in our local neighborhood schools and educators, or do we double down on insincere culture wars while depriving our kids of a quality education?**_
### **Marsha Blackburn's Platform:**
* **Rigid Testing Structures:** Champions high-stakes testing mandates, such as Tennessee’s third-grade reading retention law.
* **Privatization Focus:** Emphasizes shifting away from comprehensive public school resource investments.
* **Prioritizing National Politics:** Heavily focused on federal-style culture war battles and national talking points rather than local district needs.

### **Jerri Green's Platform:**
* **Firsthand Classroom Experience:** Having spent time teaching in classrooms while in law school in Washington, D.C., _Jerri has firsthand experience as an educator on the ground_ , and understands what it truly takes to help students learn and succeed.
* **Backing Our Teachers:** Raising salaries so we can _recruit and retain the best educators_ , and respecting their expertise instead of treating them like political targets.
* **Serving Students with Disabilities** : Ensuring that every child (especially those with specialized learning needs) has access to the resources, integrated support, and _fully funded classrooms they deserve._
* **Expanding Student Support:** Placing more counselors, nurses, and mental health professionals in our schools so _every student feels safe and supported._
* **Rejecting Private Voucher Schemes:** Stopping the push to funne _l taxpayer dollars into private and unaccountable alternatives_ , and instead investing that money into public school infrastructure, art programs, and localized learning.

Tennesseans deserve a leader whose primary focus is _the wellbeing of our students and teachers,_ not national political theater. **Jerri Green understands that a strong public school system is the backbone of our local communities and our state's economic future.** If you believe, like Jerri does, that Tennessee's children are worth fighting for,_** [chip in $10 or more today, to fuuel Jerri's campaign for Tennessee's students and teachers, and to help us keep spreading this message across every corner of the state.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138041829/642779420/1843264678?refcode=08-27_Education&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWU1OTZjMC0zZmEyLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTliZWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_ND9tkqiVSnypqTmVZZmk4pQwiROrkwg6471zaO7Y3w=)**_ _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [DONATE $10](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138041830/642779421/1755811102?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=08-27_Education&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWU1OTZjMC0zZmEyLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTliZWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_ND9tkqiVSnypqTmVZZmk4pQwiROrkwg6471zaO7Y3w=)

body:
Each bus means more volunteers knocking on doors in the races that will determine the balance of power for the next two years.
#
Hi there,
Matt Caffrey here, Senior Organizing Director at Swing Left. I want to give you a quick update on the Ground Truth Bus Program.
**Less than three weeks after we announced our $100,000 goal to send 33 buses of volunteers to swing districts between now and November 3rd, we’ve already raised $36,000 thanks to the generous support of this incredible community.**
That’s enough funds raised to secure 12 buses so far, with one already locked in for this week's Weekend of Action. It will transport volunteers from New York City to Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District, where they’ll knock on doors, engage with voters across the political spectrum, and build the trust that leads to votes for Democrats—including for Paige Cognetti’s campaign to unseat Republican Congressman Rob Bresnahan.
And this is only the beginning! Between now and Election Day, we’ll be sending buses from even more cities like Chicago and San Francisco to neighboring swing districts and states where volunteers can make the biggest difference.
Each bus means more volunteers knocking on doors in the races that will determine the balance of power for the next two years, so we’re going all out in an effort to make the biggest possible impact.
**But in order to execute on all of our plans, we still need to raise another $64,000 for the Ground Truth Bus Fund before November 3rd. The earlier we raise the funds, the earlier we can lock in buses and help eager volunteers knock on doors in swing districts that might have been harder to get to otherwise.[So if you can, please consider making a donation today to help us get as many volunteers as possible to the swing districts and states where the midterms will be decided.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&refcode=em20260827-2586&t=1&akid=2586%2E1562180%2E00O5tZ)**
**[Donate To The Ground Truth Bus Fund](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&refcode=em20260827-2586&t=2&akid=2586%2E1562180%2E00O5tZ)**
Thank you again for the incredible support so far—we’ll make sure to keep you updated as we get closer and closer to Election Day.
Matt Caffrey
Senior Organizing Director, Swing Left

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. We need your support now. | | | | = Friend, I'm LaMonica McIver, Congresswoman for New Jersey's 10th Congressional District. The Third Circuit panel refused to dismiss the Trump administration’s case against me. This is disappointing and dangerous for our democracy, and I want to be clear: This is not over. I believe the court got it wrong here and we are looking at all possible next steps. The administration will not stop me from doing my job or standing for what is right, but I need you now more than ever. = = To protect the people, their elected representatives must be able to conduct oversight of the executive branch without fear of retaliation. The court’s decision chills that authority and emboldens the Trump administration to keep going after our most vulnerable communities, those who try to defend them, and anyone who dares hold the president or his lackeys accountable. But the people need accountability from this administration. We have seen how ICE has terrorized our neighborhoods, we have seen what Trump’s agenda means in our communities. We can’t let them operate behind closed doors, in the dark, out of sight. Trump's DOJ has spent over a year trying to drain me of my resources, isolate me, and silence anyone who dares to hold them accountable. They want to put me in prison for 17 years for standing up and doing my job conducting oversight of ICE and DHS. We cannot let them win. The stakes here are high and your help is critical. = They don't know who they're dealing with — and they don't know the power of this team. We can show them today. | | As families across El Paso have sent their kids back to school this month, many have been met with school supplies sticker shock. **Families shouldn't have to be overwhelmed by skyrocketing costs of everything it takes to just take care of our household needs, whether that's utility and grocery bills or the school supplies their children need. Parents are having to choose between sending their kids to school with supplies they need or keeping the lights on at home — and that's unacceptable.** Thanks to Congressional Republicans' handouts to billionaires, those are exactly the sorts of decisions families across El Paso are forced to confront. And as if the cost of sending kids back to school wasn't high enough, families struggling to make ends meet may also be forced to pay more than $2,200 a year to cover school meals if cuts to SNAP and Medicaid cause them to lose automatic eligibility for free meal programs. **This is happening because Republicans chose billionaires over families when passing their One Big Beautiful Bill.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138042569/642781702/2141769129?refcode=2026-08-27-b2s&recurring=&amount=12&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=65a31f22-41a2-f111-9b33-0022482a9bea&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NWEzMWYyMi00MWEyLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTliZWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hcNkvTcT4rov0UhJvXE3wg6kV5KUlnYzv1httShrDaE=) The decisions our representatives make have dire consequences, and that's why we need fighters like Congresswoman Escobar — **who believes every child deserves access to****a strong education and the resources they need to thrive** —back in Congress this November. clean_body: | | | | As families across El Paso have sent their kids back to school this month, many have been met with school supplies sticker shock. Families shouldn't have to be overwhelmed by skyrocketing costs of everything it takes to just take care of our household needs, whether that's utility and grocery bills or the school supplies their children need. Parents are having to choose between sending their kids to school with supplies they need or keeping the lights on at home — and that's unacceptable. Thanks to Congressional Republicans' handouts to billionaires, those are exactly the sorts of decisions families across El Paso are forced to confront. And as if the cost of sending kids back to school wasn't high enough, families struggling to make ends meet may also be forced to pay more than $2,200 a year to cover school meals if cuts to SNAP and Medicaid cause them to lose automatic eligibility for free meal programs. This is happening because Republicans chose billionaires over families when passing their One Big Beautiful Bill. = The decisions our representatives make have dire consequences, and that's why we need fighters like Congresswoman Escobar — who believes every child deserves access toa strong education and the resources they need to thrive —back in Congress this November. = = We need experienced leadership who'll go to bat for El Paso. | | | | | | Peter,
Josh Shapiro took more than $5 million from out of state data center interests. He rolled out the red carpet for them, offered tax breaks and fast-tracked permits, and posed for press conferences celebrating their arrival.

Families are paying more at the grocery store, at the gas pump, and for housing. Small businesses are struggling with higher costs and too much government regulation.**We need to make life more affordable, keep taxes low, rein in government spending, and create an economy where working families can get ahead again.** Those are the priorities I’ll take with me to Congress.We came out of the primary with tremendous momentum, but now we have to carry it all the way to the finish line. That means continuing to get our message in front of voters across Southwest Washington every single day.I’m incredibly grateful for how far we’ve come and for everyone who has helped us get here. subject: Hard choices
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
School supplies or groceries. New shoes or the electric bill.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260827-6649-footer&t=1&akid=6649%2E420207%2EQBd4vS)
Peter,
It's back-to-school season, and for too many families across the country, that means hard choices. School supplies or groceries. New shoes or the electric bill.
Meanwhile, Trump has made a choice of his own: starting an illegal war in Iran with no congressional approval and no plan. And it’s working families who are paying for it.
Families are paying higher prices at the store and at the pump while wages stay flat and overtime protections get gutted.
**This reality is a direct result of choices made by this administration.**
That's why I'm fighting for real solutions:
* **The Domestic Workers Bill of Rights** , so domestic workers like caregivers or cleaners get the protections they've been denied for generations.

* **The Raise the Wage Act** , so your paycheck actually covers rent.

* **The Job Protection Act and the PTO Act** , so nobody has to choose between a sick kid and a paycheck.

* **The Restoring Overtime Pay Act** , so working extra hours means getting paid for it.

Working families didn't ask for a war in Iran, and they shouldn't have to pay for one at the checkout line. But in order to keep up this fight, I’m counting on your grassroots support.
[**Will you pitch in $3 today to help me keep growing our progressive movement ahead of the midterm elections?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260827-1.Ss7kbD&refcode=em20260827-6649&amount=3&t=2&akid=6649%2E420207%2EQBd4vS)

| | **The Big Picture ** Republicans have complete control of the federal government and they are using it to protect their House majority by any means necessary. Taking back the House is the only way to put a check on this administration and that means holding every competitive seat Democrats have. NY-04 is one of them. **Where Things Stand**
* **This district is one of the most competitive in the country.** New reporting has named this district one of the top House targets on Long Island, and identified Laura as the most vulnerable first-term Democrat that Republicans are working to unseat.
* **Long Island is trending redder.** Republican Bruce Blakeman is running to unseat New York's Democratic governor, and local Republicans have made steady gains across Nassau and Suffolk counties. Republicans believe that shift gives them an opening in NY-04.
* **Trump personally traveled to Nassau County this month to campaign for Laura's opponent.** A Republican outside group has pledged $22 million in ad spending across Long Island this fall, on top of tens of millions already spent nationally promoting the GOP's agenda.
* **The GOP have their candidate.** Laura's opponent has Trump's endorsement and a place on the NRCC's list of top-priority candidates, putting the full financial weight of the national party behind her campaign.

body:
State officials do not have to surrender voter information because Trump threatens our mail | |
---
Peter, **** **Trump does not have to successfully keep ballots out of the mail if he can scare state officials into surrendering first.** That is the danger behind his administration’s demand for states to turn over information on people voting by mail. The proposed USPS rule would force states into a new federal ballot system containing voters’ names, addresses, and ballot barcode information. **Postmaster General David Steiner then told Congress that states refusing to participate could have their outbound ballot mail rejected.** While a Supreme Court decision lifted one injunction and led to the lifting of the nationwide injunction blocking the USPS from moving forward with Steiner’s plan, the Court did not decide whether Trump’s order or Steiner’s scheme is constitutional. Even if a new nationwide injunction is put in place after new court filings, the uncertainty while the legal cases are moving forward just strengthens the need for secretaries of state to act. **That makes the message to every Secretary of State even more urgent.** We must make sure they do not voluntarily hand over voter information because Donald Trump and his Postmaster General threaten what might happen next. **Their hands are not tied.** [**Tell your Secretary of State to refuse Trump’s voter-data demands and publicly insist that USPS deliver every lawful ballot without delay or political conditions.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3--Y0ibn7K-x2ovBHaGSIkm-fd7asJP-LZP5maomfea2F6GqIbxfPc1BPPoCOGzdmKmLqzaJasI2xgovzTeZsEOSu1HyC-m4XMnvxqSeD-VoxXCbdtm6v3FDrE4UAWlQuw-mneO0dPWXKUR6HdoVrmVnh37o2o556_3Icz4ZK7ANb4LniJSokVF776Dt26P-E1o5GSRfqL6Veg6IBfyr3Mz109eirlu2pAtduXzxprqxMqixg9JA-0S7TOe1Nxo4FJl5HUMYPZOzIWZKj7lTP9hj0IMMlvYGcFFHCz-QBO1kPQm2myezLQQRBEEW_sC-KN99Txuukj2wZ3WPl1mhGxUcgQx2sQGikrrSziu9jbqxB2Vytnnben9VYThrKoILgG-jurU7vYeYpvxXvfi_qzCcXW03FT624Km4FkBQWxXXrw-2GtAOvBh1n1YPMitnqGeKajQx8x9TEjYzNmupl818KbmPdrLERX9C2ntUOK6WQ/4tj/se1tv6KWS8qMFfMNqTWCWg/h0/h001.667PRCyKa1oPzn7qeDDGiaz6ByrjEGUYHGWAKL9ZUT4) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3--Y0ibn7K-x2ovBHaGSIkm-fd7asJP-LZP5maomfea2F6GqIbxfPc1BPPoCOGzdmKmLqzaJasI2xgovzTeZsEOSu1HyC-m4XMnvxqSeD-VoxXCbdtm6v3FDrE4UAWlQuw-mneO0dPWXKUR6HdoVrmVnh37o2o556_3Icz4ZK7ANb4LniJSokVF776Dt26P-E2eB5Fl9rLBSuvv7vSKiNTokqy1ezaeJFhiFmZWTvSgaQiCRBAaJDC4o714o2uDxGqBH0CD4_cdtOuFucIRLNykVB8VpMYsHOtQBrHPevORRvKRmKHEN-JIM69OyITdyqA2fulXGvxSFQjEFmFDSzyBAQO9IdOqihk8zUGVEg7Aue5H6s0h9S8pDZ4rd5DdfD7rLrSuTtmCbu8LgtDmeGc7vDTxy260auoDojwOAfDqRRPRVPXQYidqMR34nEsSHEOCR1yohEI4ii0m1v8IgLkWkCjfHG0aFxYksps6KO3cDw/4tj/se1tv6KWS8qMFfMNqTWCWg/h1/h001.M-Gz7dA-a0XnM5O4UX_NT_mh72LF-9I43b40GjTuP-k)

**The Postal Service itself acknowledges in its proposed rule that it has no legal responsibility for managing state voter rolls or administering federal elections within the states.** Yet the same proposal would make USPS the gatekeeper deciding whether states have satisfied new federal requirements before their ballot mail is even accepted.
That gives away the game. **This administration is reaching beyond delivering the mail and trying to put the federal government between eligible voters and their ballots.**
Our state leaders cannot help make that possible. They should protect voter information, defend their authority to administer elections, and make clear ahead of Election Day that threats from Washington will not determine whether eligible voters receive their ballots.
This is exactly when organizing matters. Trump is counting on intimidation and confusion. We can answer with thousands of people making one demand together: **Hands off our vote. Every eligible voter should be able to vote, every vote cast should be counted, and the will of the people should decide who governs.**
[**Send a message to your Secretary of State and demand that they refuse Trump’s voter-data grab and stand up to threats against ballot delivery.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3--Y0ibn7K-x2ovBHaGSIkm-fd7asJP-LZP5maomfea2F6GqIbxfPc1BPPoCOGzdmKmLqzaJasI2xgovzTeZsEOSu1HyC-m4XMnvxqSeD-VoxXCbdtm6v3FDrE4UAWlQuw-mneO0dPWXKUR6HdoVrmVnh37o2o556_3Icz4ZK7ANb4LniJSokVF776Dt26P-E1oDoiGkRbmD0JfKhtTUg-xAsjnsPIC7Gvq8s17SYM8FjNmF-AGAvongMLzWKK0sjyMjBWIr357ZM1Lv0ChcoREcOFYQhYih4FTtdlV1_P9s-chJa1w7jya6UVa1HQQmyNniH63i1Jh_WQ_gsxEYw4gzXGGiEDQOviWJ--KwuhYuIOy9mKpHgMR1gv4n4xhRTV8iQ0i5KE2omS2rXTHdFPFQ6pZS3aV3LlFAjgxy-oyCUM_jtoftA2G1OvQjELF7YkXTPVpUbwza8TSVsV8uZxbF6nBKG2uus-LTczR-s76fw/4tj/se1tv6KWS8qMFfMNqTWCWg/h2/h001.ZOBY6hAXL2tSQxXiAehFvyFIGw5A104nutZebM43OJI)
Let’s protect our vote,
-OnePA

This piece by Raj Patel, a research professor at the Lyndon B. Johnson School of Public Affairs and a member of the International Panel of Experts on Sustainable Food Systems, and Jim Goodman, a retired dairy farmer, looks at the way hyperscalers are approaching the construction of data centers in rural communities and the rights those communities have. The piece is part of Drop Site's ongoing collaboration with Barn Raiser to put a focus on rural politics with a newsletter running through November.
